abstract: The U.S. shale boom has profoundly increased crude oil movements by both pipelines-the traditional mode of transportation-and railroads. This paper develops a model of how pipeline investment and railroad use are determined in equilibrium, emphasizing how railroads' flexibility allows them to compete with pipelines. We show that policies that address crude-by-rail's environmental externalities by increasing its costs should lead to large increases in pipeline investment and substitution of oil flows from rail to pipe. Similarly, we find that policies enjoining pipeline construction would cause 80-90% of the displaced oil to flow by rail instead.
abstract_zh: 美国页岩气繁荣深刻改变了原油运输方式，既包括传统管道运输，也涉及铁路运输。本文构建了一个模型，探讨管道投资与铁路使用如何在均衡中决定，强调铁路的灵活性使其能够与管道竞争。我们表明，通过提高原油铁路运输成本来解决其环境外部性的政策，应导致管道投资大幅增加，并将石油流量从铁路转向管道。同样，我们发现，禁止管道建设的政策将导致80-90%的转移石油改由铁路运输。
title: Environmental Consequences of Hydrocarbon Infrastructure Policy

abstract: In this paper we provide new estimates of the impact of unions on nonunion wage setting. We allow the presence of unions to affect nonunion wages both through the typically discussed channel of nonunion firms emulating union wages in order to fend off the threat of unionisation and through a bargaining channel in which nonunion workers use the presence of union jobs as part of their outside option. We specify these channels in a search and bargaining model that includes union formation and, in our most complete model, the possibility of nonunion firm responses to the threat of unionisation. Our results indicate an important role played by union wage spillovers in lowering wages over the 1980-2010 period. We find de-unionisation can account for 38% of the decline in the mean hourly wage between 1980 and 2010, with two-thirds of that effect being due to spillovers. Both the traditional threat and bargaining channels are operational, with the bargaining channel being more important.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了工会对非工会工资设定影响的新估计。我们允许工会的存在通过两种途径影响非工会工资：一是通常讨论的非工会企业为抵御工会化威胁而模仿工会工资的渠道；二是通过谈判渠道，非工会工人将工会工作的存在作为其外部选择的一部分。我们在一个包含工会形成的搜索与谈判模型中具体化了这些渠道，并在我们最完整的模型中，考虑了非工会企业对工会化威胁可能作出的反应。我们的结果表明，在1980年至2010年期间，工会工资溢出效应在降低工资方面发挥了重要作用。我们发现，去工会化可以解释1980年至2010年间平均小时工资下降的38%，其中三分之二的影响归因于溢出效应。传统的威胁渠道和谈判渠道均发挥作用，且谈判渠道更为重要。
title: The Impact of Unions on Nonunion Wage Setting: Threats and Bargaining
title_zh: 工会对非工会工资设定的影响：威胁与谈判

abstract: In this essay, I begin with the pioneering contribution of James Brander's doctoral dissertation to our understanding of international trade under oligopolistic competition. I then mention some of our early joint work showing that oligopoly creates a profit-shifting role for import tariffs and export subsidies. Our work also includes the role of subsidies to R&D/investment for international profit shifting in an oligopoly setting in which firms make sequential decisions with respect to R&D and exports. Trade policy incorporating considerations of rent- or profit-shifting is often referred to as “strategic trade policy.” After a very brief consideration of some criticisms concerning the generality of strategic trade policy results, I turn to a few thoughts on the recent move toward a much more protectionist US trade policy. I argue that a consideration of profit-shifting effects and subsequent investment and location decisions by large oligopolistic firms inside or outside the United States is essential for an understanding of the overall gains and losses from US trade policy.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我首先回顾了詹姆斯·布兰德博士论文对寡头竞争下国际贸易理解的先驱性贡献。随后，我提及了我们早期的一些合作研究，这些研究表明寡头垄断为进口关税和出口补贴创造了利润转移的作用。我们的工作还涵盖了在寡头垄断环境中，企业就研发与出口做出序贯决策时，研发/投资补贴在国际利润转移中的作用。将租金或利润转移考量纳入其中的贸易政策常被称为“战略性贸易政策”。在简要探讨了关于战略性贸易政策结果普遍性的一些批评之后，我转而思考近期美国贸易政策向更加保护主义方向转变的几点看法。我认为，考虑利润转移效应以及美国境内外大型寡头企业随后的投资和选址决策，对于理解美国贸易政策的整体得失至关重要。
title: Considering trade policy: Then and now
title_zh: 考虑贸易政策：过去与现在

abstract: We investigate the role of industrial relations for working from home during and after the COVID- 19 pandemic in Germany. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) for the years 2020 to 2023 and a special COVID sample (SOEP-CoV) for 2020 and 2021, we examine how collec- tive bargaining and plant-level co-determination are associated with the incidence and frequency of working from home. Controlling for worker, firm, occupation, and industry characteristics, we find that employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement are less likely to work from home and do so less frequently than uncovered employees. In contrast, the incidence and frequency of working from home are positively associated with the presence of a works council.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了新冠疫情期间及之后德国劳资关系对居家办公的影响。利用2020至2023年德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP）及2020至2021年新冠专项样本（SOEP-CoV），我们考察了集体谈判与工厂层面共同决策机制如何影响居家办公的发生率与频率。在控制劳动者、企业、职业及行业特征后，研究发现：受集体谈判协议覆盖的员工居家办公可能性更低且频率更少，而企业职工委员会的存在则与居家办公的发生率及频率呈正相关。

abstract: We model a stablecoin issuer that optimises capital, cash and bond holdings under persistent stablecoin flows. Absent regulation, the issuer holds little capital and favours interest-bearing but less-liquid bonds over cash. This exposes coin-holders to default risks and poses systemic spillovers via price impact of bond fire-sales. How can regulation mitigate these risks? We consider capital and liquidity thresholds as usable buffers. They can be breached in stress but discipline issuers by triggering additional redemptions, thus endogenising stablecoin flows. The thresholds work through asymmetric channels. While the liquidity threshold only raises cash holdings, the capital threshold increases both capital and cash. Both thresholds mitigate default and spillover risks, suggesting they are substitutes. However, they are complements for regulators targeting both risks. Using stablecoin flows and US Treasury market depth, we calibrate a two-way mapping that enables regulators to recover capital-liquidity threshold combinations implied by chosen risk targets (and vice-versa).
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个稳定币发行商的模型，该发行商在持续稳定的币流下优化资本、现金和债券持有量。在缺乏监管的情况下，发行商持有少量资本，并倾向于持有有息但流动性较低的债券而非现金。这使币持有者面临违约风险，并通过债券抛售的价格影响产生系统性溢出效应。监管如何缓解这些风险？我们考虑将资本和流动性阈值作为可用的缓冲机制。这些阈值在压力时期可能被突破，但通过触发额外赎回对发行商形成约束，从而内生化稳定币流动。阈值通过非对称渠道发挥作用：流动性阈值仅提高现金持有量，而资本阈值则同时增加资本和现金。两种阈值均能缓解违约和溢出风险，表明它们具有替代性。然而，对于同时针对这两种风险的监管者而言，它们又具有互补性。利用稳定币流动和美国国债市场深度数据，我们校准了一个双向映射关系，使监管者能够根据选定的风险目标反推出资本-流动性阈值的组合（反之亦然）。
title: Making stablecoins stabler(r): can regulation help?
title_zh: 使稳定币更稳定：监管能否发挥作用？

abstract: Using a recent and comprehensive data set covering nine of the most actively traded currencies on a monthly basis from 1995 to 2024, this paper explores the presence and potential drivers of herding behaviour in foreign exchange rate forecasts. The dataset features an average of 40–50 forecasters per currency, representing a broader range of currencies, a longer time frame, and a larger cross section of forecasters than is commonly found in the FX herding literature. Our results provide mixed evidence on herding, where the balance tends towards anti-herding conclusions.While some revision-based tests suggest herding when current consensus forecasts are used, this evidence weakens considerably when lagged information is employed. In contrast, forecast-error based tests, Bernhardt et al. statistics, and over-reaction regressions more often point to anti-herding, particularly at longer horizons. Overall, we interpret the findings as suggesting thatdifferences among forecasters are largely attributable to heterogeneous views, noise, or idiosyncratic error rather than systematic convergence toward the consensus. When alternative explanations for expectation formation or revisions are considered, the main findings remain unchanged across a wide range of measures, including different types of uncertainty and FX predictors such as the forward premium, the real exchange rate, and the depreciation rate. JEL Classification: C10, C22, F31, F47, G17
abstract_zh: 本文利用1995年至2024年涵盖九种最活跃交易货币的月度高频综合数据集，探究外汇汇率预测中羊群行为的存在性及其潜在驱动因素。该数据集平均每种货币包含40-50位预测者，相较于外汇羊群行为研究文献，其覆盖货币范围更广、时间跨度更长、预测者截面规模更大。研究结果为羊群行为提供了混合证据，整体结论更倾向于反羊群行为。当采用当前共识预测时，部分基于修正的检验显示存在羊群行为，但使用滞后信息后该证据显著减弱。相比之下，基于预测误差的检验、Bernhardt等人统计量及过度反应回归更常指向反羊群行为，尤其在较长预测期限中。总体而言，我们认为预测者间的差异主要源于异质性观点、噪声或特质性误差，而非系统性趋同于共识。在考虑预期形成或修正的替代性解释后，主要结论在涵盖不同类型不确定性及远期升水、实际汇率、贬值率等外汇预测因子的广泛指标体系中保持稳健。JEL分类号：C10, C22, F31, F47, G17
title: Herding in the foreign exchange market

abstract: In an ample-reserves framework, administered rates anchor money markets but suppress information from unsecured interbank trading. We recover that information by isolating the small interbank segment of the federal funds market. Using high-frequency bank-level data, we employ deposit shocks as an instrument for bank borrowing demand. Our analysis reveals that non-bank lenders, such as Federal Home Loan Banks, supply funds elastically, whereas bank lenders exhibit price inelasticity, which intensifies as their reserve balances decline, particularly for bankers’ banks. This interbank segment highlights distributional frictions in the federal funds market that emerge well before aggregate reserves become scarce and provides new evidence on monetary policy transmission in an ample-reserves regime.
abstract_zh: 在充足准备金框架下，管理利率锚定货币市场，但抑制了无担保银行间交易的信息。我们通过分离联邦基金市场中规模较小的银行间交易板块来恢复这些信息。利用高频银行层面数据，我们将存款冲击作为银行借款需求的工具变量。分析表明，联邦住房贷款银行等非银行贷方弹性供给资金，而银行贷方则表现出价格缺乏弹性，且随着其准备金余额下降（尤其是针对银行家的银行）这一特征愈发显著。该银行间交易板块凸显了在总准备金变得稀缺之前就已出现的联邦基金市场分配摩擦，并为充足准备金制度下的货币政策传导提供了新证据。
title: A Tale of Demand and Supply for Central Bank Reserves

abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
abstract_zh: 我们系统梳理了1968年至2020年间美联储工作人员在公开材料中向联邦公开市场委员会提交的1265份替代情景分析。这些情景分析的频率和复杂程度持续提升，通常围绕基准预测构建一系列可能结果。我们构建了包含六大类别的分类体系：总需求、总供给、外部风险、金融状况、财政政策及预期变化。工作人员的风险定性评估与情景构成形成互补。通过将情景预测与实际结果对比发现，即便在数值预测存在偏差时，最精准的情景往往仍能预判重大宏观经济走势，这揭示了情景分析在央行风险管理中的价值与局限性。

abstract: According to administrative data, as many as 25 million children between the ages of 5 and 16 are out-of-school in Pakistan. However, little is known about where these children are in relation to available public and private schooling options. This paper brings together novel data from satellite imagery, the population census, government school censuses of public schools, and publicly available location data on private schools to understand the out-of-school phenomenon at the community level. The paper uses satellite imagery analysis and machine learning methods to present estimates of the accessibility of schools and to describe the whitespace between schools. The paper relies on administrative data from more than 137, 000 public schools and documents the existence of more than 72, 700 private schools using publicly available location data. The approach suggests that 21.7 million children (49 percent of the total) are enrolled in private schools, higher than previously reported official estimates. The paper also presents detailed data on how the out-of-school population, accessibility, and whitespace are distributed geo-spatially across Pakistan. As an application of the strength of using satellite imagery, it analyzes the effect of a major flood event in 2022 on accessibility, whitespace, and catchment areas. Doing so suggests that the 2022 floods affected the schooling of approximately 3.5 million children in Pakistan. Lastly, an in-person ground-truthing survey conducted about 18 months after the floods is used to corroborate the findings. Together, the data sets and methods presented in this paper have applications for both day-to-day monitoring of school infrastructure as well as pre- and post-disaster planning efforts in Pakistan and elsewhere.
abstract_zh: 根据行政数据，巴基斯坦有多达2500万5至16岁儿童失学。然而，关于这些儿童与现有公立及私立教育资源的空间分布关系，目前知之甚少。本文整合了卫星影像、人口普查、公立学校行政普查及私立学校公开位置数据等新型数据集，从社区层面解析失学现象。通过卫星影像分析与机器学习方法，本文估算了学校的可达性，并描述了学校之间的"空白区域"。研究基于超过13.7万所公立学校的行政数据，并利用公开位置数据确认了超过7.27万所私立学校的存在。分析表明，2170万儿童（占总数的49%）就读于私立学校，这一比例高于此前官方报告的估计值。本文还详细呈现了失学人口、可达性及空白区域在巴基斯坦地理空间上的分布情况。作为卫星影像应用优势的例证，本文分析了2022年特大洪水事件对学校可达性、空白区域及学区范围的影响，结果显示该洪水影响了巴基斯坦约350万儿童的学业。最后，通过洪水发生约18个月后开展的实地验证调查，进一步佐证了研究结论。本文提出的数据集与方法体系，不仅适用于巴基斯坦及其他地区学校基础设施的日常监测，也可服务于灾前预防与灾后重建规划工作。
title: Where Are Pakistan’s Out-of-School Children ? Mapping Accessibility of Schooling Using Satellite Data and Machine Learning Methods with an Application to the 2022 Floods

abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of societal aging on income inequality in Malaysia, to date and in the coming decades. The study starts from the hypothesis that, all things equal, aging exerts upward pressure on inequality (Deaton and Paxson (1994, 1995)). Drawing on nationally representative household survey data over the past two decades, the study finds evidence in support of this hypothesis in Malaysia. This picture becomes even sharper when projecting inequality levels for the years when Malaysia is forecast to reach aged (2045) and super-aged (2056) status. Estimates show that between 2022 and 2056, overall inequality of individual incomes could rise by as much as 13 percent due to aging. The analysis then demonstrates that expansion of a social pension system would attenuate this projected rise in inequality. The paper also undertakes counterfactual exercises simulating the expansion of an old age social pension with various design variants. The variants considered would expand existing social transfers for older people. Given the public revenue and spending patterns in Malaysia, some of these design options are potentially manageable from a fiscal perspective. The analysis suggests that, relative to the observed situation in 2022, wider coverage of social pensions could have resulted in lower inequality in household per capita income among older individuals (by 12–26 percent), thereby lowering overall inequality (by 4-9 percent). This inequality-reducing effect of social pensions becomes even more marked when projecting estimates of inequality for 2045 and 2056. Moreover, the findings show that expanded pensions would have resulted in a lower headcount poverty rate in 2022 by 1.3–4.2 percentage points among the 60+ population, and by 0.5–1.9 points among the overall population.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了马来西亚当前及未来数十年人口老龄化对收入不平等的影响。研究基于"在其他条件不变的情况下，老龄化会加剧不平等压力"这一假设（Deaton & Paxson, 1994, 1995）。通过利用过去二十年间具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，本研究发现马来西亚的数据支持该假设。当预测马来西亚达到"老龄化社会"（2045年）和"超老龄化社会"（2056年）年份的不平等水平时，这一趋势更为显著。估算显示，2022年至2056年间，仅因老龄化因素，个人收入总体不平等程度可能上升高达13%。进一步分析表明，扩大社会养老金体系将缓解这一预期中的不平等加剧趋势。本文还开展了反事实模拟，考察不同设计方案的老年社会养老金扩面效果。所考虑的方案将扩大现有针对老年人的社会转移支付。基于马来西亚公共收入与支出模式，部分设计方案在财政层面具有潜在可行性。分析表明，相较于2022年观测到的实际情况，扩大社会养老金覆盖率可使老年人家庭人均收入不平等程度降低12%-26%，进而使总体不平等程度下降4%-9%。当对2045年和2056年的不平等水平进行预测时，社会养老金的这种不平等缓解效应更为显著。此外，研究结果显示，扩大养老金覆盖可使2022年60岁以上人口贫困发生率降低1.3-4.2个百分点，总人口贫困发生率降低0.5-1.9个百分点。
title: Counteracting the Impact of Societal Aging on Income Inequality : A Case Study of Malaysia
title_zh: 应对社会老龄化对收入不平等的影响：马来西亚案例研究

abstract: This report presents an EU-wide stocktake of Integrated Territorial Development Strategies (ITDSs) implemented under Cohesion Policy 2021–2027, drawing on data from STRAT-Board, the JRC–DG REGIO platform monitoring integrated territorial approaches. The dataset covers 87 Managing Authorities, 110 programmes and 1, 426 strategies - around 70% of all ITDSs - representing the most comprehensive evidence available for this programming period. Integrated Territorial Development (ITD) accounts for EUR 41.3 billion (~11% of total EU Cohesion Policy contributions), with uptake varying considerably across Member States due to differences in governance systems, administrative capacity and strategic interpretation. Integrated Territorial Investment (ITI) is the most widely used delivery mechanism, followed by Other Territorial Tools (OTTs) and Community-led Local Development (CLLD). While Sustainable Urban Development (SUD) remains central, most strategies target small and medium-sized territories: 85% cover areas below 250, 000 inhabitants and nearly half focus on territories under 50, 000. Over half span mixed urban–rural geographies, reflecting the importance of functional territorial linkages. Financially, SUD strategies mobilise substantially higher per-capita investments than non-SUD strategies, which tend to support smaller-scale, community-oriented interventions. Thematic priorities concentrate on integrated territorial development, biodiversity, energy efficiency and sustainable mobility. Governance arrangements are generally formalised, though practices vary in strategy selection, project identification and monitoring. Overall, the findings highlight the growing importance and heterogeneous implementation of ITD, underscoring the need to strengthen local capacity and enhance place-based impact.
abstract_zh: 本报告基于STRAT-Board（欧盟委员会联合研究中心与区域政策总司监测综合区域方法的平台）数据，对2021-2027年凝聚政策框架下实施的欧盟范围内综合区域发展战略（ITDSs）进行了全面评估。数据集涵盖87个管理机构、110个项目和1426项战略（约占全部ITDSs的70%），是本规划周期内可获得的最全面证据。综合区域发展（ITD）涉及413亿欧元资金（约占欧盟凝聚政策总投入的11%），各成员国因治理体系、行政能力和战略解读差异导致实施程度显著不同。综合区域投资（ITI）是最广泛采用的实施机制，其次为其他区域工具（OTTs）和社区主导地方发展（CLLD）。尽管可持续城市发展（SUD）仍居核心地位，但多数战略聚焦中小型区域：85%覆盖人口低于25万的区域，近半数关注人口不足5万的区域。超过半数战略涵盖城乡混合地理空间，反映出功能性区域关联的重要性。在资金配置方面，SUD战略的人均投资额显著高于非SUD战略，后者更倾向于支持小规模、社区导向的干预措施。主题优先领域集中于综合区域发展、生物多样性、能源效率和可持续交通。治理安排普遍实现规范化，但在战略选择、项目识别和监测环节存在实践差异。总体而言，研究结果凸显了ITD日益增长的重要性与实施异质性，强调需加强地方能力建设并提升基于地域的影响力。

abstract: The effects of the bank levy in Poland on the broadly defined credit market (including on loan rates and volumes) appear to be well documented, with the use of the standard difference-in-differences (DID) method. However, as, for example, Borusyak et al. (2024) note, in a setting with staggered treatment (as in the case of the bank levy in Poland), and different effects of the treatment in time and between cross-sections, the method might provide biased estimates. None of the studies to date used the heterogenous DID method that addresses this drawback. In this research note I use the heterogenous DID method to estimate the consequences of the bank levy. I also discuss other methodological choices. Among other things, I find that the bank levy has lowered deposit rates, raised rates on loans for house purchases, and changed the composition and the level of bank assets. However, I find no longer-term crowding out of credit by government bond securities (while the latter did increase, the former did not increase) or effects on bank profitability. The use of a more advised method did not lead to results in stark contrast with the earlier literature applying methods for causal inference.
abstract_zh: 尽管大量实证研究记录了劳动力和住房市场中的歧视现象，但这两个市场之间的比较性见解仍然有限。我们通过对比五个受法律保护领域——种族与民族、性别与性别认同、健康与残疾、性取向以及社会出身——在两个市场中的歧视程度来填补这一空白。我们采用分层贝叶斯元回归方法，对2000年至2024年间全球通信审计研究的数据进行分析。在此过程中，我们考虑了元数据的多层次结构，包括研究、群体、地点和时间等组成部分。我们的元分析揭示了歧视的结构性差异：种族与民族歧视在劳动力市场中最为严重，而基于社会出身的歧视则在住房市场中最为突出。针对发表偏倚的频率学稳健性检验也得出了类似的结果。

abstract: The 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure drove fertilizer prices sharply higher, prompting a broad federal response focused on supply-side capacity, logistics, and producer income support. This paper examines the demand-side channel that has received less policy attention: the margin at which corn producers may reduce nitrogen fertilizer application rates in response to elevated input prices. The agronomic literature suggests reductions of 12 to 16 percent are feasible without measurable expected yield loss; this paper examines a more conservative 5 percent scenario. Two features of the Federal Crop Insurance Program, Good Farming Practices standards and the multi-year Actual Production History calculation, may create marginal friction for producers contemplating reduction under shock-price conditions, though neither is likely determinative relative to agronomic and weather considerations. Simulation results suggest a 5 percent reduction across insured corn acres would conserve roughly 300, 000 short tons of nitrogen, raise federal indemnities by approximately $0.10 billion, and leave approved insurance provider returns above the Standard Reinsurance Agreement target. The paper closes by asking whether existing FCIP mechanisms, GFP interpretation guidance, yield-modification provisions, and AIP make-whole arrangements, warrant further examination in the current price environment.
abstract_zh: 2026年霍尔木兹海峡封锁导致化肥价格大幅上涨，促使联邦政府从供给侧产能、物流及生产者收入支持等方面采取广泛应对措施。本文聚焦于政策关注较少的消费侧传导机制：玉米生产者在投入品价格高企时可能降低氮肥施用量的边际空间。农学文献表明，在不造成可测量的预期产量损失前提下，12%至16%的减施幅度具有可行性；本文则采用更为保守的5%情景进行分析。联邦农作物保险计划的两项机制——良好农业操作规范标准与多年实际产量历史计算法——可能对生产者在价格冲击条件下考虑减施行为产生边际摩擦，但相较于农艺与气象因素，两者均不构成决定性影响。模拟结果显示，若参保玉米种植面积统一减施5%，可节约约30万短吨氮肥，联邦赔付额将增加约1亿美元，同时经批准的保险机构收益率仍高于标准再保险协议目标。本文最终提出：在当前价格环境下，现有FCIP机制、GFP解释指南、产量调整条款及AIP补偿安排是否需要进一步审查。

abstract: With India facing highest US reciprocal tariff of 50%, this paper estimates the Direct and Indirect effects of the tariff shock on Indian Textile industry. Using a CES demand model, we estimate the counterfactual demand under 50% and 25% tariff scenarios, structured into two stages. In the first stage, we quantify the tariff induced import changes of 656 textile products at HS 6-digit level and decompose into Direct Tariff effect and Third country tariff effect (Indirect). In the second stage, we quantify the transmission effect along the supply chain using I-O tables. Our analysis shows that US textile imports from India would decline by over US$ 6.6 billion under 50% tariff. Apparel and Made ups face the largest losses. Given the inter-industry linkages, first-order indirect effects are US$ 4.6 billion, including US$ 1.4 billion within the textile sector. Chemicals, agriculture, and trade services account for roughly 40% of these upstream losses. The alternative 25% tariff scenario results in a decline of US$ 2.1 billion in US textile imports, implying that the punitive tariff accounts for the additional US$ 4.5 billion. We conclude that India should negotiate for 25% or lower tariff and focus on alternate markets.
abstract_zh: 面对美国对印度征收50%的最高互惠关税，本文估算了关税冲击对印度纺织业的直接与间接影响。通过采用CES需求模型，我们模拟了50%和25%两种关税情景下的反事实需求，并分两个阶段进行分析。第一阶段，我们量化了关税对656种HS六位码纺织产品进口变化的影响，并将其分解为直接关税效应和第三国关税效应（间接效应）。第二阶段，我们利用投入产出表量化了供应链上的传导效应。分析表明，在50%关税下，美国从印度进口的纺织品将减少超过66亿美元，其中服装和制成品损失最大。考虑到行业间关联，一阶间接效应达46亿美元，其中纺织业内部占14亿美元。化学品、农业和贸易服务约占这些上游损失的40%。在25%关税的替代情景下，美国纺织品进口将减少21亿美元，这意味着惩罚性关税导致了额外的45亿美元损失。我们得出结论：印度应争取25%或更低的关税，并聚焦于替代市场。

abstract: Using a novel dataset covering the complete history of individual-level web traffic and digital subscriptions from a major metropolitan newspaper in the United States between 2020 and 2024, we investigate consumers' willingness to pay for different categories of news content, with particular focus on the kinds of coverage believed to generate civic externalities. Our identification strategy relies on the quasi-random arrival of paywall events which force consumers to subscribe if they wish to continue reading. Using this variation, we estimate a model of consumer demand and construct the optimal staff allocation for the paper under different counterfactual revenue models: a fully subscription-based model and a fully ad-supported model. Our results suggest that readers are willing to pay for local reporting, and that measures of demand based only on time-use substantially underestimate the value of “hard” news coverage on topics like local politics and public health. However, digital subscription revenues alone are insufficient to cover staff costs even at the highest revenue-generating sections of the paper. We use our model to estimate the subsidy required to expand the newspaper's production of investigative coverage.
abstract_zh: 利用一项涵盖2020至2024年间美国某大都市报纸个体层面网页浏览与数字订阅完整历史的新数据集，我们研究了消费者对不同类别新闻内容的支付意愿，尤其聚焦于被认为能产生公民外部性的报道类型。我们的识别策略依赖于付费墙事件的准随机出现——这些事件迫使消费者若想继续阅读则必须订阅。借助这一变化，我们估计了消费者需求模型，并在两种反事实收入模式下构建了报纸的最优人员配置：完全订阅制模式与完全广告支持模式。研究结果表明，读者愿意为本地报道付费，而仅基于时间使用量的需求测度会显著低估本地政治与公共卫生等“硬新闻”报道的价值。然而，即便在报纸收入最高的板块，仅凭数字订阅收入也不足以覆盖人员成本。我们利用模型估算了扩大报纸调查性报道生产所需的补贴额度。
title: What do news readers want?
title_zh: 新闻读者想要什么？

abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.

abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62,000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
abstract_zh: 当人口增长停滞且人均实物消费趋于饱和时，传统供给侧增长模型已无法解释发达经济体的持续放缓。本文提出"需求迭代速度"概念——即单位时间内特定产品或服务的重复购买频率，并将其嵌入消费支出的国民核算分解框架。研究表明，消费增长率等于人口增长率、单次交易消费量增长率与平均迭代速度增长率之和。这一分解揭示出，在后增长时代，迭代速度成为经济增长的决定性结构变量，为解释从耐用品基础设施到高频数字服务的历史增长引擎更替提供了统一视角。我们将该框架应用于香港这一成熟小型开放经济体，识别出四个可支撑其长期增长的高迭代部门。

abstract: Korea now faces rapid demographic decline due to ultra‑low fertility and accelerated aging. According to Statistics Korea, the population peaked at 51.75 million in 2024 and is projected to fall below 40 million by 2065. This demographic contraction is expected to intensify labor market imbalances. Several studies project widening labor shortages over the next 5–10 years. The Korea Employment Information Service (2025) suggests that the labor force will decline from 2030 and approximately 820, 000 more workers will be needed to fill the labor demand by 2033. The Korea Labor Institute (2024, 2025) also estimated that a shortage of 2.98 million workers (2024–2028) will expand to 6.18 million (2025–2033). The degree of labor shortages varies by sectors and regions. ICT services, healthcare and welfare, logistics, hospitality, and agriculture are the sectors that are exposed to the highest risk of labor shortages. Some provinces are already experiencing difficulties in hiring qualified workers due to declining population. Apart from the demographic change, labor market imbalance is intensified by structural changes due to geopolitical and technological factors. Geopolitical factors—including strategic competition between the United States and China, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the Russia–Ukraine war—have heightened global supply chain instability, prompting major economies to strengthen domestic and regional competitiveness in key advanced industries such as artificial intelligence, biotechnology, semiconductors, and secondary batteries. This, combined with the decline in the economically active population across advanced economies, has exacerbated labor shortages in strategic high-tech sectors. In response, major countries are actively implementing policies to attract highly skilled foreign talent, which puts pressure on the supply of talent in Korea. Labor shortages increase production costs, reduce corporate profitability, heighten inflationary pressures, and undermine potential economic growth. Attracting more foreign labor in both skilled and unskilled occupations is increasingly being considered as a potential response to labor market imbalances, particularly labor shortages. However, several challenges remain to be addressed. These include intensifying competition among advanced economies to attract talent, conflict between free-market principles and existing (often rigid) visa regimes, and the wide-ranging economic, social, cultural, and political consequences of immigration. Resolving labor market imbalances is essential to sustaining long-term growth potential. Although foreign workers cannot fully offset aggregate labor shortages, they may be able to alleviate supply constraints in specific industries and skill categories. Promotion of labor mobility can be a plausible option as long as it is accompanied by policy measures to minimize associated side effects. Jang et al. (2025) conducted two empirical analyses to estimate the effect of immigration on the labor market imbalances. First, the study examines the impact of the free labor movement in the EU on labor market imbalances. The EU is an early adopter of immigration and a supranational entity operating one of the most advanced and proactive immigration regimes. In particular, examining the effects of the EU’s flexible and inclusive immigration policies can provide meaningful policy implications for Korea. Second, the report analyzes Korea’s Employment Permit System (EPS) to assess the extent to which domestic policy measures have contributed to alleviating labor shortages. Noting the expansion of the EPS—a low-skilled labor inflow mechanism—during the post–COVID-19 recovery phase, the study quantitatively evaluates how effectively this policy has mitigated labor shortages across regions. This brief will summarize the key methods and results of those analyses and derive policy implications from them.
abstract_zh: 韩国正因超低生育率与加速老龄化面临急剧的人口衰退。据韩国统计厅数据，人口于2024年达到5175万峰值后，预计到2065年将跌破4000万。这种人口收缩预计将加剧劳动力市场失衡。多项研究预测未来5-10年劳动力短缺将持续扩大。韩国雇佣情报院（2025）指出，劳动力将从2030年开始减少，到2033年需新增约82万工人才能满足劳动力需求。韩国劳动研究院（2024, 2025）也估算，2024-2028年间298万人的劳动力缺口将在2025-2033年间扩大至618万人。劳动力短缺程度因行业和地区而异：信息通信技术服务、医疗福利、物流、住宿餐饮及农业面临最高风险；部分道因人口减少已出现合格劳动力招聘困难。除人口结构变化外，地缘政治与技术因素引发的结构性变革也加剧了劳动力市场失衡。地缘政治因素——包括中美战略竞争、新冠疫情及俄乌冲突——加剧了全球供应链不稳定性，促使主要经济体强化人工智能、生物技术、半导体、二次电池等关键尖端产业的国内及区域竞争力。这一趋势叠加发达经济体经济活动人口减少，导致战略高技术产业劳动力短缺加剧。为此，主要国家正积极实施吸引高技能外籍人才的政策，对韩国人才供给形成压力。劳动力短缺推高生产成本、降低企业盈利能力、加剧通胀压力并削弱潜在经济增长。吸引更多技能与非技能外籍劳动力正日益被视为应对劳动力市场失衡（特别是劳动力短缺）的潜在方案。然而，仍需解决若干挑战：发达经济体间人才争夺竞争加剧、自由市场原则与现行（通常僵化的）签证制度间的冲突，以及移民带来的广泛经济社会文化政治影响。解决劳动力市场失衡对维持长期增长潜力至关重要。尽管外籍劳动力无法完全弥补总体劳动力缺口，但可能缓解特定行业与技能类别的供给约束。只要配套政策能最小化相关副作用，促进劳动力流动便是可行选择。Jang等（2025）通过两项实证分析评估移民对劳动力市场失衡的影响：首先，研究考察欧盟自由劳动力流动对劳动力市场失衡的影响——欧盟作为移民政策先行者与超国家实体，其先进且积极的移民制度运作经验可为韩国提供重要政策启示；其次，报告分析韩国雇佣许可制（EPS），评估国内政策措施缓解劳动力短缺的实际效果。研究聚焦后疫情复苏期低技能劳动力流入机制EPS的扩张，定量评估该政策对区域劳动力短缺的缓解成效。本简报将概述上述分析的核心方法与结果，并提炼政策启示。

abstract: We investigate integration by parts (IBP) formulae for stochastic Volterra equations and we establish the smoothing effect of the expectation. Due to the inherent path-dependent dynamics of this class of processes, standard Bismut--Elworthy--Li (BEL) formulae and lifting procedures fail to produce representations for directional derivatives with respect to the initial curve. We exhibit a new type of fractional IBP for these derivatives which, by means of the Riemann--Liouville fractional derivative, interpolates between the standard chain rule and a pure BEL formula with Cameron--Martin path directions. Our assumptions describe precisely the trade-off between the direction's and the test function's regularities. Crucially, we reveal that more roughness leads to more smoothing: for a power-law kernel with Hurst parameter $H\in(0, 1/2)$, we show that the expectation is differentiable along constant directions provided that the test function has H\"older continuity $\beta>2H$. The proof of the formula relies on a careful analysis of the conditional expectation's temporal regularity and on the well-posedness of its Riemann--Liouville derivative. We complement these results with a BEL formula along all square integrable directions whenever the noise is additive, a second order BEL formula and an application to forward and rough volatility models. In the latter case, the derivative is interpreted as the sensitivity with respect to the whole initial forward variance curve.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了随机Volterra方程的分部积分公式，并建立了期望的平滑效应。由于这类过程固有的路径依赖动力学特性，标准的Bismut--Elworthy--Li (BEL)公式和提升方法无法生成关于初始曲线的方向导数表示。我们针对这些导数提出了一种新型分数阶分部积分公式，该公式通过Riemann--Liouville分数阶导数，在标准链式法则与包含Cameron--Martin路径方向的纯BEL公式之间进行插值。我们的假设精确描述了方向正则性与测试函数正则性之间的权衡关系。关键的是，我们发现更粗糙的路径会导致更强的平滑效应：对于Hurst参数$H\in(0, 1/2)$的幂律核，我们证明只要测试函数具有Hölder连续性$\beta>2H$，期望沿恒定方向是可微的。该公式的证明依赖于对条件期望时间正则性的细致分析及其Riemann--Liouville导数的适定性。我们进一步补充了以下结果：当噪声为加性时，沿所有平方可积方向的BEL公式、二阶BEL公式，以及在远期和粗糙波动率模型中的应用。在后一种情况下，导数被解释为对整条初始远期方差曲线的敏感性。
title: Functional integration by parts formulae for stochastic Volterra processes

abstract: This study examines the relationship between the Financial Health Index of Brazilians (Índice de Saúde Financeira do Brasileiro, I-SFB) and credit behavior, focusing on two central questions: (1) how different levels of financial health relate to the likelihood of delinquency, and (2) how transitions between stages of late payments and delinquency vary according to the financial health levels measured by the I-SFB. The results reveal a significant association between higher I-SFB scores and a lower likelihood of delinquency, with the financial behavior and financial security dimensions showing the strongest link to reduced risk. The study also highlights potential improvements to the financial skills dimension, which showed no significant relationship with delinquency. A revision of the items comprising this dimension is put forth, incorporating more practical aspects of financial knowledge application. For the private sector, the study proposes using the I-SFB as a diagnostic tool to develop new financial products that are better aligned with the population’s needs, thereby fostering more robust financial health. The implementation of integrated strategies, combining behavioral interventions, practical financial education, and consumer protection policies, is essential to achieve more sustainable outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究关系专用性学习如何影响出口与贸易融资的联合动态。基于智利微观企业数据，本文发现新出口商最初依赖预付款交易，随着贸易关系成熟逐步转向提供贸易信贷，且在风险更高的目的地及经验较少的企业中，这一转型速度更快。受此现象启发，本文构建了一个整合外国需求与交易对手风险学习机制、以及企业内生出口与贸易融资选择的一般均衡贸易模型。该模型用于探究学习机制与风险在塑造出口调整中的作用，并量化贸易融资成本冲击对总出口的影响。分析表明，出口对上述冲击的反应取决于目的地的风险水平，且长期贸易关系的中断会放大这种影响。
title: International Trade Finance and Learning Dynamics

abstract: This is the first study to estimate the impact of sports gambling legalization on food sufficiency using the staggered implementation of state laws between 2021-2023. By analyzing Google searches for online sportsbooks and legal wagers, we show that interest in sports gambling increases sharply following legalization. Applying an imputation-based difference-in-differences design to biweekly Household Pulse Survey (HPS) data, we find that legalized sports gambling reduces household food sufficiency by 2.1 percent among working-age adults without a college degree, which translates to a 10.5 percent decline among active bettors. This effect is cyclical, persisting for three-to-five months during NFL seasons. Additionally, the declines in food sufficiency are larger among households with adults aged 25-44 and racial/ethnic minorities. Using additional data from the HPS, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and Current Population Survey, our exploration of mechanisms suggests that the negative effects on food sufficiency operate through financial distress rather than changes in mental health or labor supply. A back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates that legalization of sports gambling in nine states resulted in an additional 284, 000 food-insufficient households and $130.2 million in excess healthcare expenditures annually.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用2021至2023年间各州法律分阶段实施的情况，评估体育博彩合法化对食品充足性的影响。通过分析在线体育博彩平台的谷歌搜索量及合法投注数据，我们发现合法化后公众对体育博彩的兴趣急剧上升。采用基于插补的双重差分法对双周家庭脉搏调查（HPS）数据进行分析，结果显示，体育博彩合法化使未获得大学学位的劳动年龄人口家庭食品充足性下降2.1%，相当于活跃投注者群体中该指标下降10.5%。这一效应呈现周期性特征，在NFL赛季期间持续三至五个月。此外，在25-44岁成年人家庭及少数族裔群体中，食品充足性下降幅度更为显著。通过整合HPS、行为风险因素监测系统及当前人口调查的补充数据，我们对作用机制的探索表明，食品充足性受到的负面影响主要通过财务困境传导，而非心理健康或劳动力供给的变化。粗略估算显示，九个州的体育博彩合法化每年导致新增28.4万个食品不足家庭，并产生1.302亿美元的额外医疗支出。

abstract: This paper examines the gender pay gap among youth aged 15-29 in Egypt, Jordan, and Palestine using the 2021 Labor Force Surveys. The analysis identifies the main determinants of wages for young men and women and estimates the extent of gender-based wage disparities. The Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition is used to distinguish the share of the wage gap explained by observable characteristics from the unexplained component, often associated with discrimination. Melly's quantile decomposition is applied from the 10th to the 90th percentile. The findings show that youth wages are positively associated with higher education and professional experience. A significant gender pay gap favoring young men is found in Egypt and Palestine, with Egypt showing the largest disparity. In Jordan, the average gap is small and statistically insignificant, with young women slightly out-earning young men. However, the decomposition results reveal a significant positive unexplained component across all three countries, suggesting persistent disparities after accounting for observable factors. The quantile analysis further shows a "sticky floorâ€ effect in Egypt and a "glass ceilingâ€ effect in Palestine.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2021年劳动力调查数据，考察埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦15-29岁青年的性别工资差距。分析确定了青年男性和女性工资的主要决定因素，并估算了基于性别的工资差异程度。采用奥克萨卡-布林德分解法，将可观测特征解释的工资差距部分与通常归因于歧视的未解释部分区分开来。同时，应用梅利分位数分解法，从第10百分位到第90百分位进行分析。研究结果表明，青年工资与高等教育和职业经验呈正相关。在埃及和巴勒斯坦，存在显著有利于青年男性的性别工资差距，其中埃及的差距最大。在约旦，平均差距较小且统计上不显著，青年女性收入略高于青年男性。然而，分解结果显示，三个国家均存在显著的正向未解释成分，表明在控制可观测因素后，差距依然持续存在。分位数分析进一步揭示了埃及的“粘地板”效应和巴勒斯坦的“玻璃天花板”效应。
title: Examining the Gender Pay Gap Among Youth: Insights from Egypt, Jordan, and Palestine

abstract: Public K–12 systems legally require children to attend a large number of instructional hours each year, but official budgets recognize only the cost of adult labor. This creates an accounting puzzle: is there any fiscal object that explicitly values student time? We propose a framework to quantify this fiscal nonrecognition. We define Compulsory Student Hours (CSH) as the total mandated student time, where CSH = Σᵢ EᵢHᵢwᵢ, Eᵢ is enrollment in group i, Hᵢ is required hours per year for group i, and wᵢ is a compulsion weight. We impute a dollar value, Imputed Student Time Value (ISTV), by multiplying CSH by an hourly benchmark V. We identify any actual Recognized Student-Time Dollars (RSD), defined as direct payments to students for required attendance, and compute the Student Time Recognition Rate (STRR), where STRR = RSD/ISTV. Using national data of approximately 49.2 million public K–12 students, roughly 1, 000 statutory hours per year, and a conservative federal minimum-wage benchmark of $7.25 per hour, the resulting ISTV is on the order of $3.57 × 10¹¹. In ordinary public finance there are effectively no direct student-time payments, yielding STRR ≈ 0. These are order-of-magnitude illustrations: if H = 1, 080 or V = $15, ISTV rises, but RSD remains approximately zero. The results highlight a stark asymmetry: schools’ budgets explicitly account for teacher and staff time, but institutionally required student time has virtually no direct fiscal counterpart. This is a descriptive accounting exercise, not a claim that students are owed wages or a policy proposal. The contribution is a neutral, replicable method for measuring the gap between adult labor accounting and student-time accounting in K–12 finance.
abstract_zh: 公立K–12系统依法要求儿童每年完成大量教学时数，但官方预算仅承认成人劳动力的成本。这产生了一个会计谜题：是否存在明确评估学生时间价值的财政对象？我们提出一个量化这种财政不承认现象的框架。将强制性学生时数（CSH）定义为法定要求的学生总时间，其中CSH = Σᵢ EᵢHᵢwᵢ，Eᵢ为第i组学生注册人数，Hᵢ为第i组学生每年要求时数，wᵢ为强制权重。通过将CSH乘以每小时基准值V，估算出隐含学生时间价值（ISTV）。我们识别任何实际存在的学生时间认可美元（RSD），即因要求出勤而直接支付给学生的款项，并计算学生时间认可率（STRR），其中STRR = RSD/ISTV。基于全国约4920万公立K–12学生数据、每年约1000法定学时以及保守的联邦最低工资基准7.25美元/小时，估算出的ISTV约为3.57×10¹¹美元。在常规公共财政中，实际上不存在直接的学生时间支付，因此STRR≈0。这些是数量级示例：若H=1080或V=15美元，ISTV上升，但RSD仍近似为零。结果凸显出显著的不对称性：学校预算明确核算教师和员工时间，但制度性要求学生时间几乎无直接财政对应项。这是一项描述性会计练习，并非主张学生应获工资或政策建议。其贡献在于提供一种中立、可复制的方法，用于衡量K–12财政中成人劳动核算与学生时间核算之间的差距。
title: Fiscal Nonrecognition of Student Time: Measuring Compulsory Student Hours in U.S. Public K–12 Education
title_zh: 学生时间的财政不承认：衡量美国公立K-12教育中的强制性学生学时

abstract: 미·중 간 기술 패권 경쟁이 지속되면서 미국 등 주요국은 핵심 과학기술 분야에서 자국 기술과 산업을 보호·육성하기 위한 전략을 강화하고 있다. 각국 정부는 연구개발 투자를 확대하는 동시에 기술 보호 및 육성을 위한 법·제도적 기반을 정비하고 있으며, 기술 경쟁력 확보뿐만 아니라 국가 안보와 산업 생태계 강화를 목표로 하고 있다. 주요 선진국들은 핵심 기술 분야의 발전을 지원하면서 불필요한 규제를 완화하고, 기술 보호를 위한 새로운 규제를 도입하는 등 정교한 정책 설계를 시도하고 있다. 이러한 규제 혁신 전략을 분석함으로써 선진국의 과학기술 발전 전략과 혁신 생태계 조성 방식, 산업 발전을 위한 정책적 접근법을 비교·분석할 필요가 있다. 본 연구에서는 기존 연구에서 다루지 않았던 과학기술 분야별 규제 혁신 전략들에 대한 다면적 분석을 통해 빠른 속도로 변하고 있는 과학기술 분야 미래 규제 환경에 대한 우리의 효과적 대응 전략을 제시한다. As the competition for technological hegemony intensifies between the U.S. and China, major advanced countries around the world, including the U.S., are increasingly strengthening their strategies to protect and foster their technologies and industries in core science and technology fields. The governments of individual countries are expanding R&D investment, reorganizing legal and institutional foundations for technology protection and fostering, and aiming to strengthen national security and industrial ecosystems as well as securing technological competitiveness.

abstract: I. Gaps in Global AI Adoption As artificial intelligence (AI) is shaping the global economy and society as a general-purpose technology (GPT), there is increasing concern that disparities in countries’ capacity to adopt AI may further widen. While AI holds significant potential to enhance productivity, foster economic growth, and expand trade, its benefits may become concentrated in a limited number of leading countries and firms due to the unequal distribution of technology, capital, talent, and data. In particular, many developing countries face structural constraints in adopting AI, primarily due to insufficient digital infrastructure, limited human capital, and underdeveloped institutional frameworks. Over the medium to long term, these constraints risk exacerbating global growth gaps and socioeconomic inequality. We employ the IMF’s AI Preparedness Index (AIPI) to assess national AI adoption capacity by income group. As shown in Figure 1, there are substantial cross-national gaps in AI preparedness. High-income countries generally have foundations in regulation and ethics, digital infrastructure, human capital, and innovation. Upper-middle-income countries are heterogeneous as a group, but many are likely to have a strong willingness to accelerate innovation based upon a substantial level of human capital. For lower-middle- and low-income countries, improving digital infrastructure is an urgent priority while also treating development of human resources as a key policy consideration (see Figure 2). These cross-country gaps are closely linked to differences in the level of progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals. SDG indicators show a strong correlation with AIPI, suggesting that the achievement of the SDGs has a significant influence as a foundational condition for AI readiness (see Table 1).

abstract: Countries borrow in dollars because dollar debt markets are deep and liquid. This paper develops a theory of when that dominance becomes fragile because countries have inherited dollar liabilities but increasingly earn yuan-linked revenues. In the model, countries begin with dollar-denominated sovereign debt. Geopolitical fragmentation raises their yuan revenue share through two channels: higher trade barriers with dollar-linked markets shift exports toward yuan-linked markets, and higher costs of using dollars in that trade make yuan settlement more attractive. Governments then face a choice: repay dollar debt using revenues that are less dollar-linked, default, or restructure into yuan. The paper identifies a liquidity spillover from restructuring: dollar-to-yuan restructurings deepen yuan debt markets, lowering refinancing costs and encouraging additional restructurings. The model shows when fragmentation produces limited restructuring and when it triggers a self-reinforcing shift from dollar debt to yuan debt. A cascade requires the liquidity feedback from yuan restructuring to be stronger than the dispersion in countries’ yuan revenue exposure.
abstract_zh: 各国以美元借贷，是因为美元债务市场深度大、流动性强。本文构建了一个理论，探讨当各国继承美元负债但收入日益与人民币挂钩时，这种主导地位何时会变得脆弱。在模型中，各国最初持有以美元计价的主权债务。地缘政治碎片化通过两个渠道提高其人民币收入份额：与美元挂钩市场的贸易壁垒提高，促使出口转向人民币挂钩市场；以及在该贸易中使用美元的成本上升，使人民币结算更具吸引力。政府随后面临选择：用与美元关联度较低的收入偿还美元债务、违约，或重组为人民币债务。本文识别出重组带来的流动性溢出效应：美元转人民币的重组深化了人民币债务市场，降低了再融资成本，并鼓励更多重组。模型展示了碎片化何时导致有限的重组，以及何时触发从美元债务向人民币债务的自我强化转变。这种级联效应需要人民币重组的流动性反馈强于各国人民币收入敞口的分散程度。

abstract: What accounts for cross-country heterogeneity in exchange-rate responses to U.S. monetary policy shocks? Using daily data around Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements for 34 countries from 2001 to 2019, we show that countries with deeper financial markets experience larger currency depreciations following contractionary U.S. monetary policy shocks. This amplification is concentrated in forward-guidance shocks rather than contemporaneous target-rate surprises. The result is robust to alternative measures of financial market depth and to controls for domestic monetary policy responses, broad dollar movements, and various country characteristics. The amplification fades within approximately one month, suggesting that financial market depth matters primarily for high-frequency exchange-rate adjustment. A parsimonious portfolio-adjustment model interprets these empirical patterns by linking market depth to lower rebalancing costs and by treating forward guidance as news about future interest-rate differentials.
abstract_zh: 什么因素导致了各国汇率对美国货币政策冲击的异质性反应？利用2001年至2019年34个国家在联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后的日度数据，我们发现，金融市场深度较大的国家在遭遇紧缩性美国货币政策冲击时，会经历更大幅度的货币贬值。这种放大效应集中于前瞻性指引冲击，而非同期目标利率意外变化。该结果在采用替代性金融市场深度指标、控制国内货币政策反应、广义美元走势以及多种国家特征后依然稳健。放大效应约在一个月内消退，表明金融市场深度主要影响高频汇率调整。一个简约的投资组合调整模型通过将市场深度与较低的投资组合再平衡成本相联系，并将前瞻性指引视为关于未来利差的信息，对这些实证模式进行了解释。
title: US Monetary Policy, Exchange Rates, and Delayed Portfolio Adjustments
title_zh: 美国货币政策、汇率与延迟的投资组合调整

abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
abstract_zh: 地缘政治风险已成为全球金融市场的核心驱动因素，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰及近期中东冲突等事件引发了资产价格的剧烈波动和市场波动性的上升。本文简要探讨了地缘政治风险如何影响美国银行估值，以及哪些机构最为脆弱。通过跨境贷款、海外子公司和交易活动，银行面临多方面的地缘政治风险敞口，这些风险可能通过信贷损失、融资市场中断和手续费收入变化影响其盈利能力。银行的估值进而影响其融资成本和资本筹集能力，最终影响对实体经济的信贷供给。若地缘政治风险对不同银行的影响存在差异，则可能在金融体系内造成不均衡的脆弱性，这对金融稳定具有重要影响。

abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.

abstract: Many charitable organizations invite potential donors to first join a registry before soliciting donations from those who have joined. Behavioral theories suggest that the choice architecture of registry enrollment can influence not just participation but also future giving. Some approaches may be relatively more likely to increase the likelihood of joining but reduce the subsequent propensity to donate and the amount donated, while other methods might have the opposite effect. We experimentally test four behavioral theories – overhead aversion, status quo bias, reciprocity, and moral consistency – in a two-stage donor engagement model. We find that (1) disclosing registry-related overhead costs decreases donations, (2) changing the default enrollment method (op-in vs. opt-out) does not affect enrollment nor donations, (3) targeting reciprocity by offering a small gift conditional on joining the registry boosts enrollment but not donations, and (4) targeting moral consistency by requesting an upfront contribution does not decrease the likelihood of joining the registry and can improve charity returns. Our findings emphasize how subtle differences in the design of early-stage donor approaches can influence longer-term fundraising outcomes.
abstract_zh: 许多慈善组织会先邀请潜在捐赠者加入登记册，随后再向已加入者募捐。行为理论表明，登记注册的选择架构不仅会影响参与行为，还会影响未来的捐赠意愿。某些方法可能更易提高加入登记册的可能性，但会降低后续捐赠倾向及金额；而另一些方法则可能产生相反效果。我们通过两阶段捐赠者参与模型，对四种行为理论——管理费用厌恶、现状偏差、互惠原则与道德一致性——进行了实验检验。研究发现：（1）披露与登记册相关的管理费用会减少捐赠；（2）改变默认注册方式（选择加入与选择退出）对注册率及捐赠均无影响；（3）通过提供注册后附赠小礼品来触发互惠机制，虽能提升注册率，但未增加捐赠额；（4）通过要求预先捐款来触发道德一致性，既未降低注册可能性，还能提升慈善收益。我们的研究结果强调，早期捐赠者接触方式设计中的细微差异，可能对长期筹款成效产生深远影响。
title: Designing Donor Registries: Behavioral Drivers of Enrollment and Giving

abstract_zh: 2026年3月燃油价格急剧上涨，为澳大利亚可持续出行行为转变创造了潜在窗口。然而，哪些人群具备改变出行方式的条件仍鲜为人知。一项于2026年4月开展的针对2177名澳大利亚成年人的全国代表性在线调查，捕捉了危机前的出行行为、出行方式转变考量及支持持续改变的条件。可解释机器学习（XGBoost、SHAP、监督k-means聚类）识别出对步行、骑行、电动自行车及公共交通具有适应性的亚群。四分之三的受访者已改变或考虑改变出行行为。步行是最常采用的新出行方式（20%），而规避出行是最常见的适应行为（41%）。经济困难与年轻化是适应性的主导预测因子。监督聚类揭示了三种反复出现的典型群体——经济压力大的年轻人、在职城市专业人士及缺乏服务覆盖的偏远地区居民。实现公平的可持续出行成果，需要交通系统为所有人群提供可负担且安全的替代方案。
title: Global fuel shocks as catalysts of sustainable travel behaviour change

abstract: We examine the impact of U.S. sanctions on food security using a panel of 185 economies over 1990-2017, linking the World Food Programme (WFP) multidimensional food security indicator system to sanction episodes. Using difference-in-differences identification strategy and an event-study design, we show that sanctions significantly reduce food security in target countries, widening the gap with non-sanctioned countries by about 30 percent. Effects are concentrated in food access and stability-key dimensions of household food affordability and resilience-and are primarily driven by trade and financial restrictions. Mechanism analysis indicates that sanctions operate through both supply and demand channels. On the supply side, they reduce food imports and domestic production. On the demand side, they lower income, raise inflation and unemployment, and weaken political stability. Notably, the sanction impacts are strongest in low- and lower-middle-income countries, where food systems are more vulnerable to external shocks. These results highlight substantial and uneven humanitarian costs of sanctions for food security.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1990-2017年间185个经济体的面板数据，将世界粮食计划署（WFP）多维粮食安全指标系统与制裁事件相关联，考察美国制裁对粮食安全的影响。采用双重差分识别策略和事件研究设计，我们发现制裁显著降低了目标国的粮食安全水平，使其与未受制裁国家的差距扩大约30%。影响主要集中在粮食获取与稳定性——即家庭粮食可负担性与韧性的关键维度——且主要由贸易和金融限制驱动。机制分析表明，制裁通过供给和需求双重渠道发挥作用：在供给端，制裁减少了粮食进口和国内生产；在需求端，制裁降低了收入水平、推高了通胀和失业率，并削弱了政治稳定性。值得注意的是，制裁对低收入和中低收入国家的影响最为显著，这些国家的粮食体系更易受到外部冲击。这些结果揭示了制裁对粮食安全造成的巨大且不均衡的人道主义代价。
title: The Impact of US Sanctions on Food Security: Evidence from a Global Panel
title_zh: 美国制裁对粮食安全的影响：基于全球面板数据的证据

abstract: After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates—and, to a lesser extent, award rates—within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.
abstract_zh: 在1990年代和2000年代经历了显著增长后，美国社会保障残疾保险（SSDI）项目的参保人数自2013年起持续下降。我们利用详细的行政数据量化了各因素对SSDI参保趋势的贡献，重点关注2010年代的下降趋势。统计分解表明，2013年以来SSDI参保人数的下降绝大部分可归因于各人口群体内申请率的下降（以及较小程度上的批准率下降）。人口特征、资格条件或退出SSDI的时序变化对下降趋势的贡献微乎其微。SSDI参保率的下降主要由中低技能男性群体驱动——随着时间的推移，该群体申请SSDI的可能性降低，而就业可能性上升。与这一描述性证据一致，我们通过因果分析发现，低技能男性劳动力市场机会的改善是解释SSDI参保率下降的关键因素。我们还检验了其他几种关于SSDI申请下降的流行假说（包括上诉阶段批准率降低），但发现证据与之相悖。
title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment

abstract: The U.S. general fertility rate has fallen by 22% since 2007, a sustained decline not readily explained by economic conditions, contraceptive use, housing or childcare costs, or other commonly cited factors. We assess the potential role of a different shock: the diffusion of the smartphone. The U.S. rollout of the iPhone, the first modern smartphone, provides a natural experiment: from June 2007 through February 2011, the device was sold only on AT&T, allowing us to identify its effect from variation in AT&T’s mobile broadband coverage. Entropy-balanced Poisson and synthetic difference-in-differences event studies imply that access to the iPhone reduced births by 4.5–8.0% at ages 15–19 and 3.2–6.6% at ages 20–24, with statistically significant but smaller declines among older cohorts. Placebo analyses applied to Verizon and Sprint’s pre-2011 coverage footprint are null. Taken together, these cohort effects imply that the diffusion of the iPhone deepened the decline in births among women under 30 while suppressing the rise in births among older women. Overall, the diffusion of the iPhone explains 33–52% of the decline in the general fertility rate among women aged 15–44. National-survey evidence on time use and sexual behavior is consistent with the iPhone reducing in-person interactions, increasing pornography use, and reducing sexual frequency.
abstract_zh: 自2007年以来，美国总和生育率下降了22%，这一持续下降趋势难以用经济状况、避孕措施使用、住房或育儿成本等常见因素解释。我们评估了另一种冲击的潜在作用：智能手机的普及。美国首款现代智能手机iPhone的推广提供了一个自然实验：从2007年6月至2011年2月，该设备仅由AT&T独家销售，这使我们能够通过AT&T移动宽带覆盖范围的差异识别其影响。基于熵平衡泊松模型和合成双重差分事件研究的结果表明，iPhone的接入使15-19岁年龄段生育率下降4.5%-8.0%，20-24岁年龄段下降3.2%-6.6%，而较高年龄段虽呈现统计显著但降幅较小。针对Verizon和Sprint在2011年前覆盖范围的安慰剂分析未发现显著效应。综合来看，这些队列效应表明iPhone的普及加剧了30岁以下女性生育率的下降，同时抑制了高龄女性生育率的上升。总体而言，iPhone的普及解释了15-44岁女性总和生育率下降幅度的33%-52%。基于全国调查的时间使用与性行为证据显示，iPhone减少了面对面互动，增加了色情内容使用，并降低了性行为频率。
title: Is the iPhone Birth Control? Causal Evidence from AT&T’s 2007–2011 Carrier Monopoly
title_zh: iPhone是避孕工具吗？来自AT&T 2007–2011年运营商垄断的因果证据

abstract: We study the effect of pre-booked COVID-19 vaccination appointments using a nationwide campaign in Austria. Leveraging administrative microdata on more than 450000 initially unvaccinated adults, we exploit cross-state variation in program participation and staggered appointment timing in a difference-in-differences design. Pre-booked appointments increase vaccination on the appointment day by 0.8 percentage points (8 per 1000), with no evidence of intertemporal substitution. Effects are larger for socio-economically disadvantaged individuals and substantially weaker in areas with stronger vaccine skepticism. The findings suggest that behavioral interventions are effective when low uptake reflects frictions, but have limited impact when driven by entrenched skepticism.
abstract_zh: 我们利用奥地利全国性疫苗接种活动，研究了预先预约新冠疫苗接种的效果。基于超过45万名初始未接种成年人的行政微观数据，我们采用双重差分法，利用各州在项目参与率及预约时间安排上的差异。预先预约使接种当日的疫苗接种率提高了0.8个百分点（每千人增加8人），且未发现跨期替代效应。该效应在社会经济弱势群体中更为显著，而在疫苗怀疑论较强的地区则明显减弱。研究结果表明，当低接种率源于摩擦性障碍时，行为干预措施有效；但当其源于根深蒂固的怀疑态度时，干预效果有限。
title: Pre-Booked Vaccination Appointments as a Nudge: Evidence from a Nationwide Intervention
title_zh: 预约定点疫苗接种作为一种助推手段：来自全国性干预的证据

abstract: We use Gallup World Poll data from over 150 countries from 2009-2019 at both the individual and country levels to revisit the relationship between income and subjective wellbeing. Our inspiration is the paradox first proposed by Easterlin (1974), where higher incomes are associated with greater happiness in cross-sections, yet rising country GDP per head does not necessarily increase its average wellbeing. In our analysis subjective wellbeing (or happiness) is measured by the Cantril ladder on a 0-10 scale. Across individuals, other things equal, one unit of log income raises subjective wellbeing by 0.4 points. In other words, doubling income raises wellbeing by 0.3 points out of 10. Across countries, a crude regression of wellbeing on log per capita income gives a higher coefficient of 0.6. But, once social variables like health and social support are introduced, the picture changes. In rich countries, income no longer has a significant independent effect, either in country cross-sections or in time series. For low-income countries the result is also clear cut - income raises happiness in both cross-section and time series, whether the social variables are controlled for or not. For middle-income countries the result is mixed.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2009-2019年间覆盖150多个国家的盖洛普世界民意调查数据，从个体和国家两个层面重新审视收入与主观幸福感之间的关系。研究灵感源于伊斯特林（1974）首次提出的悖论：在横截面数据中，较高收入与更高幸福感相关，但国家人均GDP增长未必能提升其平均福祉水平。本研究中，主观幸福感（或幸福感）采用坎特里尔阶梯量表（0-10分制）进行测量。在个体层面，其他条件不变时，对数收入每增加一个单位，主观幸福感提升0.4分。换言之，收入翻倍可使幸福感在10分制中提升0.3分。在国家层面，对幸福感与人均对数收入进行简单回归，得到0.6的更高系数。然而，一旦引入健康与社会支持等社会变量，情况便发生变化。在富裕国家，无论是国家横截面数据还是时间序列数据，收入均不再具有显著的独立效应。对于低收入国家，结果同样明确——无论是否控制社会变量，收入在横截面和时间序列中均能提升幸福感。而中等收入国家的结果则呈现混合特征。
title: The Easterlin Paradox at 50
title_zh: 50年后的伊斯特林悖论

abstract: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.
abstract_zh: 医疗保险欺诈的规模有多大？欺诈者是谁？我们以医疗保险家庭健康服务（普遍认为欺诈高发领域）为研究对象，将受到联邦特别行动组起诉的家庭健康机构定义为欺诈机构。通过整合全美所有家庭健康机构的医疗保险索赔数据，以及手工收集的2009-2013年间九个联邦司法辖区特别行动组的起诉记录，我们训练机器学习模型，预测其余85个司法辖区中每家家庭健康机构若存在特别行动组时被起诉的概率。研究估算显示，2008年医疗保险家庭健康支出中有3.4%（约5.2亿美元）由欺诈性家庭健康机构开具账单。特别行动组的靶向性显著：其覆盖的九个司法辖区虽仅占家庭健康总支出的40%，却集中了65%的欺诈性支出。欺诈性家庭健康机构呈现显著特征：更依赖超高转诊量的医师，护理模式异常统一，且服务对象健康水平高于平均水平。
title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?
title_zh: 医疗保险家庭健康欺诈：规模、地域与主体

abstract: This study is the first to use population-wide birth registration data spanning 18 years, linked to Census records, to examine the relationship between a comprehensive set of socioeconomic factors and the birth weight of more than 1.2 million children in Australia, both at the mean and across the distribution. Employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother fixed-effects models, the study reports five main findings, several of which offer new insights for the literature. First, both maternal and paternal education are positively associated with children's birth weight, with stronger associations observed for maternal education and at the lower end of the birth weight distribution. Second, parental income exhibits a positive but non-linear association with birth weight, with larger effects among lower-birth-weight children. Third, relative to children living in rental housing, those born into families with mortgaged homes have higher average birth weights, whereas those born into families that own their homes outright have lower average birth weights. However, children from home-owning families exhibit higher birth weights at the lower end of the distribution but lower birth weights at the upper end. Fourth, more favourable local socioeconomic conditions are positively but non-linearly associated with birth weight, with stronger associations at the lower end of the distribution. Fifth, children born to mothers who migrated from low- or middle-income countries have lower birth weights than those born to mothers from high-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用覆盖18年的人口出生登记数据，并结合人口普查记录，考察了澳大利亚超过120万儿童出生体重与一系列社会经济因素在均值及分布层面的关联。通过采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型），研究得出五项主要发现，其中多项为现有文献提供了新见解。第一，母亲与父亲的教育水平均与儿童出生体重呈正相关，其中母亲教育的关联性更强，且在出生体重分布的低端更为显著。第二，父母收入与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，对低出生体重儿童的影响更大。第三，相较于居住在租赁住房中的儿童，出生于有抵押贷款家庭的儿童平均出生体重更高，而出生于完全自有住房家庭的儿童平均出生体重更低。然而，来自完全自有住房家庭的儿童在出生体重分布低端呈现更高体重，但在高端则呈现更低体重。第四，更有利的本地社会经济条件与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，且在分布低端关联性更强。第五，出生于来自中低收入国家母亲的儿童，其出生体重低于出生于来自高收入国家母亲的儿童。
title: Socioeconomic Inequalities in Birth Weight: Novel Distributional Evidence from Linked Population Data
title_zh: 出生体重的社会经济不平等：来自关联人口数据的新分布证据

abstract: GLP-1 therapies for obesity promise substantial health improvements, but little is known about how their benefits vary across socioeconomic and demographic groups. Using a nationally representative microsimulation model of US adults and Shapely-value decomposition, we estimate the lifetime health and economic benefits of GLP-1 treatment and examine how those gains vary across individuals. The largest differences emerge across education. Individuals with less than a high school education experience experience roughly 14% higher gains in lifetime net social value, 16-17% larger improvements in discounted generalized risk- and severity-adjusted life-years (GRASA-QALYs), and 20% greater increases in life expectancy relative to the cohort mean, whereas individuals with college degrees experience gains 15-27% below the mean across these outcomes. Black and Hispanic individuals also tend to experience larger improvements in health outcomes and social value than White individuals, including larger gains in GRASA-QALYs and life expectancy and larger reductions in diabetes risk and duration. Females likewise experience larger predicted treatment gains than men. These patterns are consistent with the idea that the largest gains arise among populations facing greater socioeconomic constraints in sustaining behavioral weight control. GLP-1 innovation may therefore mitigate inequality in obesity-related disease and survival, advancing equity in population health.
abstract_zh: GLP-1肥胖疗法有望带来显著的健康改善，但关于其收益如何在不同社会经济和人口群体间分布的研究尚不充分。通过使用具有全国代表性的美国成年人微观模拟模型和沙普利值分解方法，我们估算了GLP-1治疗带来的终身健康与经济收益，并考察了这些收益在不同个体间的差异。最大差异出现在教育水平层面：与队列均值相比，高中以下学历者在终身净社会价值上的收益高出约14%，贴现后广义风险与严重程度调整生命年（GRASA-QALYs）改善幅度高出16-17%，预期寿命增长高出20%；而拥有大学学历者在这三项指标上的收益则低于均值15-27%。黑人和西班牙裔个体在健康结果和社会价值方面的改善幅度也普遍高于白人群体，包括GRASA-QALYs和预期寿命的更大提升，以及糖尿病风险与病程的更大程度降低。女性预测的治疗收益同样高于男性。这些模式与以下观点一致：在维持行为体重控制方面面临更大社会经济约束的人群，其收益最为显著。因此，GLP-1创新可能有助于缓解肥胖相关疾病与生存率方面的不平等，促进人口健康公平。
title: GLP-1 Therapy and the Reshaping of Socioeconomic Gradients in Health
title_zh: GLP-1治疗与健康社会经济梯度的重塑

abstract: How harmful is stigma in the “real world”? Answers are elusive because stigma is difficult to measure in observational data, and isolating its effects requires exogenous variation in stigma without variation in the stigmatized trait. This study addresses these challenges by focusing on a widespread form of stigma — weight stigma — in the high-stakes setting of inpatient healthcare. BMI categories are displayed prominently to providers in electronic medical records, and obesity is heavily stigmatized socially. Thus, at the "obese" cutoff, stigma may shift discretely while the underlying trait (BMI) does not. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits this institutional feature, I find a discontinuous increase in in-hospital mortality at this cutoff, though patient health does not change. Two patterns suggest stigma-based discrimination as the mechanism. First, just-obese patients receive less diagnostic effort than almost-obese patients. Second, a physician-validated LLM identifies at the cutoff a rise in stigmatizing language in clinical notes — specifically, language that imposes moral judgment, undermines patient credibility, and stereotypes patients — among the most stigmatizing providers, who also drive the mortality result. Overall, these results suggest that stigma is a powerful social force with potentially life-or-death consequences.
abstract_zh: 污名在“现实世界”中有多有害？答案难以捉摸，因为污名在观测数据中难以衡量，且分离其影响需要污名本身的外生变化，而污名化特征保持不变。本研究通过聚焦住院医疗这一高风险场景中普遍存在的污名形式——体重污名，来应对这些挑战。电子病历中BMI类别被显著展示给医疗服务提供者，而肥胖在社会中受到严重污名化。因此，在“肥胖”临界点处，污名可能发生离散变化，而潜在特征（BMI）并未改变。利用这一制度特征，采用断点回归设计，我发现该临界点处院内死亡率出现非连续上升，尽管患者健康状况并未变化。两种模式表明污名化歧视是作用机制：首先，刚达肥胖标准的患者获得的诊断努力少于接近肥胖的患者；其次，经医生验证的大语言模型识别出，在临界点处临床记录中污名化语言有所增加——具体而言，是施加道德评判、削弱患者可信度及对患者进行刻板印象的语言——这些语言主要来自污名化程度最高的医疗服务提供者，而他们也正是死亡率上升结果的驱动因素。总体而言，这些结果表明污名是一种强大的社会力量，可能带来生死攸关的后果。
title: Deadly Stigma
title_zh: 致命污名

abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务中的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这些影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据来探究这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的解法可作为任务复杂度的自然代理变量，而解题时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的当地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线PM2.5污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。

abstract: We estimate long-run effects of Cuba's 1961 National Health Service and contemporaneous National Literacy Campaign using synthetic-control methods on newly assembled series for 21 former European colonies in the Americas, 1900--2022. Relative to synthetic Cuba, infant mortality falls 15--29 percent and average years of schooling rise 1.5--2 years; both effects are large, persistent, and robust to augmented SCM, synthetic difference-in-differences, interactive fixed effects, and matrix completion. Life-expectancy gains attenuate after 1990, consistent with the post-Soviet Special Period, suggesting that bundled health and literacy reforms permanently raise early-life survival and human capital, with smaller and less robust effects on adult longevity.
abstract_zh: 我们利用合成控制法，基于新编制的1900—2022年美洲21个前欧洲殖民地的序列数据，估算了古巴1961年国家卫生服务与同期全国扫盲运动的长期效应。与合成古巴相比，婴儿死亡率下降15%—29%，平均受教育年限增加1.5—2年；这两个效应均显著、持久，并在增强型合成控制法、合成双重差分法、交互固定效应模型及矩阵补全方法中保持稳健。预期寿命的改善在1990年后有所减弱，这与后苏联时期的“特殊时期”相一致，表明捆绑式的卫生与扫盲改革永久性地提高了早期生存率与人力资本，但对成人寿命的影响较小且稳健性较弱。
title: Long-Term Health and Human Capital Effects of Universal Health Care and Mass Literacy: Evidence from Cuba
title_zh: 全民医保与大规模扫盲的长期健康及人力资本效应：来自古巴的证据

abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa Rican initiative that combined free access to long-acting reversible contraceptives and a tailored information campaign to correct for baseline misinformation. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access – an extra year of exposure to the information campaign is equivalent to the effect of contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the policy changed the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misinformation on sexual health.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供项目的有效性。我们考察了哥斯达黎加的一项举措，该举措结合了长效可逆避孕药的免费获取和针对性的信息宣传，以纠正基线信息偏差。利用行政数据和该举措的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。我们表明信息与获取渠道具有互补性——额外一年的信息宣传接触相当于仅提供避孕药具的效果。通过性行为调查，我们显示该政策将信息来源从个人社交网络转向医疗专业人员，从而修正了性健康方面的错误信息。
title: The Complementary Role of Information and Contraceptive Access in Teen Pregnancy
title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用

abstract: One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.
abstract_zh: 衡量《平价医疗法案》（ACA）效率的一个方法是，公共资助医疗保险的覆盖增长在多大程度上降低了未参保率。利用2008-2024年美国社区调查数据，我们按收入与联邦贫困线（FPL）之比划分群体，考察了未参保率、公共保险覆盖率以及雇主提供保险（ESI）的时间趋势。我们利用各州在ACA实施中的年度差异，估算了公共保险覆盖率变化与未参保率及ESI变化之间的关联。重要的是，我们评估了ACA的总体效应——包括医疗补助扩展和市场保险覆盖——对未参保率和ESI的影响。对于家庭收入低于联邦贫困线150%的成年人，公共保险覆盖率的增加与未参保率的一对一下降相关，而ESI无变化。对于收入在联邦贫困线151%-400%之间的成年人，公共保险覆盖率每增加一个百分点，未参保率下降约0.6个百分点，ESI下降0.4个百分点（即挤出效应）。在ACA实施前ESI率较高的群体（如父母和已婚成年人）中，挤出效应更大。仅利用医疗补助扩展的变异来评估ACA对ESI的影响，会导致低估低收入成年人（低于150% FPL）的挤出效应，而高估高收入成年人（高于250% FPL）的挤出效应。我们的研究结果表明，旨在补贴高收入群体医疗保险的政策（例如增强型保费补贴）远不如旨在进一步向低收入群体扩展公共保险的政策（例如在非扩展州）有效。
title: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
title_zh: 《平价医疗法案在降低未参保率方面的效率如何？》

abstract: When do labor-market shocks become lasting health inequality? We develop and estimate a continuous-time lifecycle model of wealth, health, and skill in which medical care combines smooth maintenance with threshold-crossing repair. Adverse wage shocks push financially fragile households toward subsistence, increase toxic labor effort, delay repair, and convert temporary earnings losses into persistent biological damage. Estimated with PSID, MEPS, and RAND HRS data, the model shows that skill-biased technical change generates concentrated lower-tail losses in health, survival, and welfare. A meaningful share of this damage reflects endogenous repair failure, and the mechanism remains visible in a parsimonious general-equilibrium environment.
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场冲击何时会演变为持久的健康不平等？我们构建并估计了一个涵盖财富、健康与技能的连续时间生命周期模型，其中医疗护理兼具平滑维护与阈值修复的双重特征。不利的工资冲击使财务脆弱的家庭陷入生存困境，增加有害的劳动投入，延迟修复行为，并将暂时性收入损失转化为持续性生理损伤。基于PSID、MEPS和RAND HRS数据的估计结果显示，技能偏向型技术进步在健康、生存和福利方面产生了集中的低端损失。这种损害中有相当一部分源于内生的修复失败机制，且该机制在简约的一般均衡环境中依然清晰可辨。
title: When Economic Insecurity Becomes Biological Inequality: Delayed Repair and Lifetime Health Inequality
title_zh: 当经济不安全转化为生物不平等：延迟修复与终身健康不平等

abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district-year panel for 1994-2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，将扩展的骚乱数据与夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷相结合，评估了社区骚乱的经济影响。为解决内生性问题，我们利用印度主要印度教节日恰逢周五（周五吸引大量穆斯林群体参加每周祈祷）所产生的准随机变异，构建了衡量当地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，更高的骚乱暴露度会导致显著且持续的经济损失。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出与就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷萎缩以及市场基础设施薄弱。通过利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度有所下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。
title: The Economic Costs of Religious Riots in India
title_zh: 印度宗教骚乱的经济成本

abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how public disclosure of air pollution information affects private health insurance demand. Exploring the staggered rollout of China's real-time air pollution monitoring and disclosure program as a quasi-natural experiment, we combine household-level survey data with satellite-based pollution measures and estimate a difference-in-differences model. We find that when pollution information becomes publicly available, higher pollution levels significantly increase the likelihood of purchasing private health insurance. A one-unit increase in aerosol optical depth raises insurance coverage by about 2.2 percentage points, an economically meaningful effect given the low baseline coverage rate. The effect is robust to alternative specifications, individual fixed effects, and placebo tests. Mechanism analyses show that the response is driven by heightened pollution risk perception and health concerns rather than income or labor supply effects. The effect is stronger among more risk-averse, less educated individuals and those with lower trust in insurance. The results highlight the role of external information in shaping financial behavior and health risk management decisions.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于空气污染信息公开如何影响私人健康保险需求的新证据。以中国实时空气污染监测与公开项目的分阶段推广为准自然实验，我们结合家庭层面调查数据与基于卫星的污染测量指标，并采用双重差分模型进行估计。研究发现，当污染信息向公众公开后，更高的污染水平显著增加了购买私人健康保险的可能性。气溶胶光学厚度每增加一个单位，保险覆盖率约提高2.2个百分点，考虑到较低的基准覆盖率，这一影响具有经济显著性。该效应在替代性设定、个体固定效应及安慰剂检验中均保持稳健。机制分析表明，这一反应主要由增强的污染风险感知与健康担忧驱动，而非收入或劳动力供给效应。在风险规避程度更高、受教育程度较低及对保险信任度较低的群体中，该效应更为显著。研究结果凸显了外部信息在塑造金融行为与健康风险管理决策中的关键作用。
