abstract: We study how Venezuelan refugee inflows affect healthcare outcomes and municipal public finances in Brazil's universal, decentralized public healthcare system. For identification, we exploit cross-municipality variation in refugee exposure and use distance to Brazil's only official border crossing with Venezuela as an instrument. A one-percentage-point increase in the local refugee share raises overall mortality by 4.2 percent and infant mortality by up to 9 percent. We show these effects operate through both the poorer baseline health of arriving refugees and congestion in local health facilities. Municipalities increase the share of spending on healthcare, but absent compensating federal transfers, they do so at the expense of education's budget share. These results highlight the limits of decentralized service provision in absorbing the health and fiscal costs of concentrated migration shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了委内瑞拉难民涌入如何影响巴西全民、分权式公共医疗体系中的医疗结果与市政公共财政。为识别因果关系，我们利用各市难民暴露程度的差异，并以距离巴西唯一官方委内瑞拉边境口岸的距离作为工具变量。当地难民比例每增加一个百分点，总死亡率上升4.2%，婴儿死亡率最高上升9%。研究表明，这些影响既源于抵达难民较差的初始健康状况，也源于当地医疗设施的拥挤。各市增加了医疗支出占比，但在缺乏联邦转移支付补偿的情况下，这一调整以牺牲教育预算份额为代价。这些结果凸显了分权式服务供给在吸收集中性移民冲击带来的健康与财政成本方面的局限性。
title: Under pressure? Forced migration and public health
title_zh: 压力之下？强制迁移与公共卫生

abstract: Air pollution from natural sources is often subject to less regulatory oversight, but can still be caused by human activities. Understanding the role for policy requires quantifying the source's pollution contribution, for which there is currently no standard methodological approach. This paper uses the context of the shrinking Great Salt Lake in Utah to model air quality impacts of the highly erodible and growing area of exposed lakebed. Using four common identification strategies in the air pollution literature, and three alternative pollution measurement technologies, we find consistent evidence of meaningful pollution increases attributable to the shrinking lake in non-winter months. Estimates are relatively invariant to measurement technology but vary across identification strategies. Marginal annual costs range from $81 to $175 million per 100 km² of exposed lakebed. Scaling to the area of total exposed lakebed, annual desiccation-related health cost estimates range from $1.1 billion to $2.3 billion. Given the direct relationship between human water use in the basin and exposed lakebed, these results provide evidence for the cost-effectiveness of policies aimed at reducing consumptive water use.
abstract_zh: 自然来源的空气污染通常受到的监管较少，但仍可能由人类活动引发。理解政策的作用需要量化该来源的污染贡献，但目前尚无标准方法论。本文以美国犹他州大盐湖萎缩为背景，对高度可侵蚀且不断扩大的裸露湖床区域的空气质量影响进行建模。利用空气污染文献中四种常见的识别策略及三种替代性污染测量技术，我们发现在非冬季月份，湖泊萎缩导致显著的污染增加，且证据一致。估计值对测量技术相对不敏感，但随识别策略不同而变化。每100平方公里裸露湖床的边际年成本介于8100万至1.75亿美元之间。按总裸露湖床面积推算，与干涸相关的年度健康成本估计值介于11亿至23亿美元之间。鉴于流域内人类用水与裸露湖床之间的直接关系，这些结果为旨在减少消耗性用水的政策提供了成本效益证据。

abstract: In the context of the growing share of public workers in the Spanish labour force, this paper analyses opportunistic behaviour in sick leave duration and return-to-work probabilities among teachers. We use administrative microdata (2011-2019), transformed into an original monthly spell-level panel. The analysis employs a tailored regression within a difference-in-differences framework exploiting the academic calendar and comparing professional sick leaves among pre-university teachers in public and private schools. Results show that the timing of sick leave endings systematically responds to the school calendar. Public-school teachers display longer sick leave durations and lower return-to-work probabilities than private-school teachers, consistent with ex post moral hazard under more generous employment protection and sick leave coverage. Around the summer break, these differences become more pronounced: public-school teachers extend their leaves further relative to private-school teachers. Simultaneously, the usual gap in return-to-work probabilities temporarily reverses, with public-school teachers becoming more likely to end their leave immediately after summer. These patterns are especially strong among mid-career workers, women, and cases involving more subjective or difficult-to-diagnose injuries.
abstract_zh: 在西班牙劳动力中公共部门工作者占比日益增长的背景下，本文分析了教师群体在病假时长与返岗概率中的机会主义行为。我们采用2011-2019年行政微观数据，将其转化为原创的月度个体面板数据。分析基于双重差分框架，利用学年周期进行定制化回归，比较公立与私立学校大学预科教师的职业病假情况。结果显示，病假结束时间系统性地响应学年周期。相较于私立学校教师，公立学校教师病假持续时间更长、返岗概率更低，这与更优厚的就业保障和病假覆盖下的事后道德风险一致。在暑假前后，这些差异更为显著：公立学校教师相对于私立学校教师进一步延长病假。同时，返岗概率的常规差距暂时逆转，公立学校教师在暑假结束后立即结束病假的可能性更高。这些模式在职业生涯中期工作者、女性以及涉及更主观或难以诊断的伤病案例中尤为突出。
title: Teachers' sick leave and summer timing: an impact evaluation
title_zh: 教师病假与暑假时间安排：一项影响评估

abstract: This study uses whole-of-population linked census-administrative data to examine gender gaps in educational outcomes from early primary school through early adulthood in Australia and to assess the contribution of socioeconomic factors to these gaps either at the mean and along the distribution of educational outcomes. Leveraging the richness and large size of the linked data and employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother and twin fixed-effects models, we find that females outperform males as early as ages 5–6 across multiple developmental domains, and that this advantage persists through university. The gender gap in favour of females is larger among lower-performing students. We also find that boys benefit more than girls from growing up in more advantaged families, particularly among academically lower-performing boys. However, this advantage is observed only for outcomes measured in the early years of primary school. By contrast, for outcomes measured at the tertiary level, most indicators of socioeconomic advantage confer stronger benefits to females, especially among individuals at the lower end of the educational attainment distribution. Finally, having ruled out gender differences in birth weight—which favour males—we identify gender differences across siblings in school sector choice and early childhood health conditions, both favouring females, as potential mechanisms underlying these patterns.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用全人口关联普查与行政数据，考察澳大利亚从小学早期至成年早期的教育成果性别差距，并评估社会经济因素在均值及教育成果分布上对这些差距的贡献。借助关联数据的丰富性与大规模特征，并采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型和双胞胎固定效应模型），我们发现：早在5-6岁阶段，女性在多个发展领域已优于男性，且这一优势持续至大学阶段。女性优势的性别差距在学业表现较低的学生中更为显著。同时，成长于更优越家庭环境的男孩比女孩获益更多，尤其体现在学业表现较低的男孩群体中——但这一优势仅存在于小学早期阶段的教育成果指标。相比之下，在高等教育阶段，大多数社会经济优势指标对女性更有利，尤其对教育成就分布底端的个体而言。最后，在排除出生体重（男性占优）的性别差异后，我们识别出兄弟姐妹间在学校类型选择及儿童早期健康状况上的性别差异（两者均有利于女性），这些差异构成了上述模式的潜在机制。
title: Socioeconomic status and gender gaps in educational outcomes across the life course: New distributional evidence from linked census-administrative data
title_zh: 社会经济地位与教育成果性别差异的生命历程变化：基于关联普查行政数据的新分布证据

abstract: Urban overheating is increasingly recognised as a major public health challenge under climate change, yet existing frameworks remain heavily focused on acute medical risk and clinically vulnerable populations. This paper introduces \textit{hidden vulnerability} to describe a broader population who remain socially and economically active under ordinary conditions but experience progressive destabilisation during sustained indoor heat exposure. Drawing on a sensor-enhanced longitudinal housing survey in Southwark, London during the summer of 2023, combining indoor environmental monitoring with weekly health and wellbeing questionnaires, the study examines how overheating affects everyday urban life. The findings reveal that impacts extended well beyond thermal discomfort. Participants described cascading disruptions across physical, functional, and psychological domains, sleep loss, exhaustion, impaired self-care, reduced concentration, emotional strain, and increased caring burdens, that interacted and reinforced one another, progressively eroding the capacity to maintain ordinary routines. Critically, these processes were observed not only among participants with chronic conditions but also among those without formally recognised health vulnerabilities, suggesting that the threshold for destabilisation is lower, and more widely distributed, than existing frameworks assume. The paper argues that hidden vulnerability is an urban condition, produced by the intersection of housing quality, social infrastructure, and accumulated disadvantage. The response calls for a conceptual framework for redefining heat vulnerability beyond demographic and clinical categories, and an empirical foundation for a social cure approach to urban heat governance.
abstract_zh: 城市过热日益被视为气候变化下的一项重大公共健康挑战，然而现有研究框架仍高度聚焦于急性医疗风险及临床意义上的脆弱人群。本文提出"隐性脆弱性"概念，用以描述在常规条件下保持社会与经济活跃、但持续暴露于室内高温时经历渐进式失稳的广泛人群。基于2023年夏季在伦敦南华克区开展的传感器增强型纵向住房调查，结合室内环境监测与每周健康福祉问卷，本研究考察了过热对日常城市生活的影响。研究结果表明，其影响远超热不适范畴。参与者描述了身体、功能及心理层面的级联式干扰——睡眠剥夺、疲惫、自我照护能力受损、注意力下降、情绪压力及照护负担加重——这些因素相互交织、彼此强化，逐步侵蚀维持日常活动的能力。关键的是，这些过程不仅出现在患有慢性疾病的参与者中，也出现在无正式认定的健康脆弱性的参与者中，表明失稳阈值低于现有框架假设，且分布更为广泛。本文认为，隐性脆弱性是一种城市状态，由住房质量、社会基础设施与累积劣势的交织作用所产生。应对策略要求构建超越人口统计与临床分类的热脆弱性概念框架，并为城市热治理的社会疗愈路径提供实证基础。

abstract: A growing literature documents racial hierarchy in international institutions. I test whether formally equal rules eliminate that hierarchy in practice. The Schengen visa regime offers a hard case because member states process applications under identical law. I show that ancestral distance, a measure of perceived racial difference, predicts visa refusals. Contemporary ancestral distance drives the result. A pre-1500 measure does not, consistent with the social construction of race. A consulate-level analysis isolates the discretionary channel. Busier consulates discriminate more against ancestrally distant applicants, even though a nationality's risk profile does not change with consular workload. Routine operational pressures activate the categorical shortcuts that institutional design was supposed to prevent. A further test shows the effect is stronger where national populations hold more restrictive racial attitudes, not where institutional capacity is weakest. Harmonized rules do not eliminate international institutional racism. They push it into discretionary gaps that formal law cannot close.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献揭示了国际机构中的种族等级现象。本文检验了形式上平等的规则是否能在实践中消除这种等级。申根签证制度提供了一个典型案例，因为成员国依据相同的法律处理签证申请。研究表明，祖先距离（一种感知种族差异的衡量指标）能够预测签证拒签率。当代祖先距离是驱动这一结果的关键因素，而1500年之前的祖先距离则无显著影响，这与种族的社会建构属性一致。领事馆层面的分析揭示了自由裁量渠道的作用。工作更繁忙的领事馆对祖先距离较远的申请人歧视更严重，尽管国籍的风险特征并不随领事馆工作量变化。常规操作压力激活了制度设计本应防止的类别化捷径。进一步检验表明，这种效应在国民种族态度更保守的地区更为显著，而非在制度能力最弱的地区。统一规则并未消除国际制度中的种族主义，而是将其推向了正式法律无法填补的自由裁量空间。
title: The Discretionary Color Line in International Institutions
title_zh: 国际机构中的自由裁量种族界限

abstract: We analyze the effects of increased trade exposure to China on the Polish labor market during the period 2011–2019. Utilizing detailed industry-level data and an instrumental variable strategy based on trade flows from other Visegrad Group countries, we disentangle the impacts of import competition and access to imported intermediate inputs. We find that while import competition induced job losses in specific sectors, industries benefiting from access to Chinese intermediate inputs experienced substantial employment gains. Critically, this positive input channel effect was sufficient to offset the majority of displacement losses caused by import competition. Although manufacturing as a whole faced a slight net decline, the aggregate economy experienced net employment expansion. These results identify a “China Boost” driven by intermediate inputs, suggesting that Chinese imports act as strategic complements to domestic labor in Poland, contrasting sharply with the “China Shock” observed in the United States.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了2011-2019年间中国贸易敞口增加对波兰劳动力市场的影响。利用详细的行业层面数据，并基于维谢格拉德集团其他国家的贸易流量构建工具变量策略，我们区分了进口竞争与进口中间品获取的影响。研究发现，尽管进口竞争导致特定行业就业岗位流失，但受益于中国中间品输入的行业却实现了显著的就业增长。关键在于，这种正向的投入渠道效应足以抵消进口竞争造成的大部分岗位替代损失。虽然制造业整体面临轻微净下降，但总体经济却经历了就业扩张。这些结果揭示了由中间品驱动的"中国助推"效应，表明中国进口品与波兰国内劳动力形成战略互补关系，这与美国观察到的"中国冲击"形成鲜明对比。

abstract: We study the intergenerational distributional effects of carbon pricing during the green transition in an overlapping-generations New Keynesian model calibrated to euro-area household micro data. Climate policy generates systematic redistribution across cohorts through two channels: a labor-income channel, driven by wage compression and lower labor demand, and a financial-wealth channel, driven by asset revaluation and higher real returns. The labor- income channel dominates quantitatively , generating persistent welfare losses of up to 6 percent in permanent-consumption equivalents for working-age households, while retirees experience comparable gains. Revenue recycling can mitigate these asymmetries, requiring 40 to 68 per- cent of carbon-tax revenues to be directed toward financial-income tax relief. Monetary policy has limited influence on the overall redistributive pattern.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了绿色转型过程中碳定价的代际分配效应，基于一个以欧元区家庭微观数据校准的世代交叠新凯恩斯模型。气候政策通过两个渠道在代际间产生系统性再分配：一是劳动收入渠道，由工资压缩和劳动力需求下降驱动；二是金融财富渠道，由资产重估和实际回报率上升驱动。劳动收入渠道在数量上占主导地位，导致劳动年龄家庭的永久消费等价福利损失高达6%，而退休群体则获得相应收益。收入循环利用可缓解这种不对称性，需将40%至68%的碳税收入用于金融收入税减免。货币政策对整体再分配格局的影响有限。
title: Intergenerational Redistribution in the Green Transition
title_zh: 绿色转型中的代际再分配

abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
abstract_zh: 本研究从“国家-产业间网络”视角审视新知识（创新）的创造现状，并分析了参与“创新网络”的经济含义。迄今为止，政策制定者在推动技术发展、强化创新能力时，通常侧重于增加本国研发投资总额。然而，在现代社会中，创新无法仅凭单一国家、产业或企业自身的研发实现。创新不仅在一国内部，更跨越国界，从其他国家、其他产业通过多种渠道共享与传播至另一国家或产业，因此政策制定必须充分考虑这一点。尤其对韩国而言，网络的重要性需要再次强调。
title: 글로벌 혁신 네트워크 참여의 경제적 함의와 통상 정책방향 연구(A Study on the Economic Implications of Participation in the Global Innovation Network and Trade Policy Directions)
title_zh: 全球创新网络参与的经济含义与贸易政策方向研究

abstract: We introduce shrinkage estimators of the sample mean vector in high dimension. Our estimators share desirable properties relative to existing methods: they are distribution-free, consider bona-fide target estimators, and use simple estimators of the shrinkage intensities independent of the precision matrix which are L2 consistent in high dimension. Unlike existing estimators that impose that the whitened data be an i.i.d. matrix, we only impose i.i.d. across sample observations. We require uniform boundedness of the first four moments, and the high-dimensional asymptotics are in a general Kolmogorov setting where N/T=O(1) as T→∞, with N the mean-vector dimension and T the sample size. We consider as a target estimator either zero or the grand mean. Simulations show that our shrinkage estimators are competitive with a range of benchmark estimators, both when the theoretical assumptions are satisfied and violated. Finally, we apply our estimators to constructing mean-variance portfolios of a large number of stocks, and find that they deliver robust out-of-sample Sharpe ratios.
title: Distribution-Free Shrinkage of High-Dimensional Mean Vector

abstract: I study the cost pass-through on retail prices in two oligopolistic retail markets defined by specific physical boundaries. Using this setup, I find significant evidence that markets ultimately operate as a single one regarding their level of long-run pass-through and speed of price adjustment, possibly indicating substitution effects. Moreover, pass-through in both markets is not a function of the number of market players, which is in contrast with previous theoretical and empirical studies. Finally, I show that although vertical integration has a positive relationship with the speed of price adjustment, it does not affect long-run pass-through.
abstract_zh: 我研究了两个由特定物理边界界定的寡头零售市场中零售价格的成本传导。利用这一设定，我发现显著证据表明，就长期传导水平和价格调整速度而言，这些市场最终表现为单一市场运作，这可能暗示着替代效应的存在。此外，两个市场的传导并非取决于市场参与者数量，这与先前的理论和实证研究相悖。最后，我表明，尽管纵向一体化与价格调整速度呈正相关，但它并不影响长期传导。
title: Using Pass-Through as an Economic Tool: On Geographical Market Definition, Competition and Number of Market Players, and Vertical Relations
title_zh: 利用传导效应作为经济工具：论地理市场界定、竞争与市场参与者数量及纵向关系

abstract: This special issue brings together 21 papers that reflect the expanding scope and methodological evolution of Bayesian econometrics. We introduce a new organizing taxonomy that distinguishes between Traditional Bayesian Approaches - rooted in conjugate priors, standard likelihood-based estimation, and established Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques - and Contemporary Bayesian Frontiers, characterized by nonparametric methods, variational inference, high-dimensional shrinkage, and integration with machine learning. We further classify contributions across two broad domains covering applications in Economics (focusing on macroeconomics, microeconomics, and climate econometrics) and Finance (focusing on asset pricing, volatility, and bank business models). Across these fields, four cross-cutting themes emerge: (1) high-dimensionality, volatility, and time-varying dynamics; (2) structural identification and model uncertainty; (3) semiparametric and nonparametric flexibility; and (4) data quality, granularity, and novel data structures. This survey synthesizes the methodological and empirical contributions of the special issue, proposes a unifying framework for organizing recent advances in Bayesian econometrics, and identifies unresolved challenges and promising directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 本期特刊汇集了21篇论文，反映了贝叶斯计量经济学不断扩展的范围与方法论的演进。我们引入了一种新的组织分类法，区分了传统贝叶斯方法——根植于共轭先验、标准似然估计及成熟的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）技术——与当代贝叶斯前沿，后者以非参数方法、变分推断、高维收缩及与机器学习的融合为特征。我们进一步将贡献划分为两大广泛领域，涵盖经济学应用（聚焦于宏观经济学、微观经济学及气候计量经济学）与金融学应用（聚焦于资产定价、波动性及银行商业模式）。在这些领域中，涌现出四个跨领域主题：（1）高维性、波动性及时变动态；（2）结构识别与模型不确定性；（3）半参数与非参数灵活性；（4）数据质量、粒度及新颖数据结构。本综述综合了特刊的方法论与实证贡献，提出了一个统一框架以组织贝叶斯计量经济学的最新进展，并指出了未解决的挑战及未来研究的有前景方向。
title: Bayesian methods in economics and finance: A unified survey and taxonomy
title_zh: 经济学与金融学中的贝叶斯方法：统一综述与分类

abstract: This paper studies the effects of replacing the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) with a Universal Basic Income (UBI) in an environment where EITC take-up is incomplete. In contrast, UBI ensures full participation by design, extending benefits to households who do not take up the EITC, at the cost of higher fiscal expenditures. I study this trade-off between expanded coverage and fiscal cost using a life-cycle model with an endogenous EITC participation decision that replicates the observed eligibility and take-up patterns. The results show that a generous UBI ($12,000 annually) reduces welfare due to the substantial fiscal burden it entails, whereas a modest UBI ($3500 per year) improves welfare by reaching previously uncovered households at only a moderate fiscal cost. These findings highlight the importance of the program participation margin in evaluating policy reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在劳动所得税抵免（EITC）参与不完全的环境下，以全民基本收入（UBI）替代劳动所得税抵免的影响。相比之下，UBI通过设计确保全面参与，将福利延伸至未参与EITC的家庭，但代价是更高的财政支出。我通过一个包含内生EITC参与决策的生命周期模型来研究扩大覆盖范围与财政成本之间的权衡，该模型能够复现观察到的资格与参与模式。结果表明，慷慨的UBI（每年12，000美元）因伴随的巨额财政负担而降低福利，而适度的UBI（每年3，500美元）则通过以适度的财政成本惠及此前未被覆盖的家庭来改善福利。这些发现凸显了项目参与边际在评估政策改革中的重要性。
title: From means-tested programs to Universal Basic Income - The role of endogenous participation in transfer programs
title_zh: 从经济状况调查项目到全民基本收入——转移支付项目中内生参与的作用

abstract: This paper examines the international dimension of the post-pandemic inflation surge. We estimate an extended structural vector autoregressive (SVAR) model for Norway, Sweden, the United Kingdom, and the United States to disentangle domestic and foreign drivers of inflation. Foreign supply and demand shocks are identified through novel restrictions on import prices and trading-partner output, consistent with a simple New Keynesian model featuring firm-to-firm trade in intermediate inputs. Our results show that international demand shocks played a major role across countries. Foreign supply shocks absorb some explanatory power from domestic supply shocks, but demand factors remain the prevalent source of inflation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了疫情后通胀飙升的国际维度。我们为挪威、瑞典、英国和美国估计了一个扩展的结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，以区分国内和国外通胀驱动因素。通过针对进口价格和贸易伙伴产出的新颖约束条件，我们识别了外国供给和需求冲击，这与一个包含企业间中间投入贸易的简单新凯恩斯模型相一致。结果表明，国际需求冲击在各国中发挥了重要作用。外国供给冲击从国内供给冲击中吸收了一些解释力，但需求因素仍是通胀的主要来源。
title: Demand shocks during the post-pandemic inflation surge: An international perspective
title_zh: 后疫情通胀飙升期间的需求冲击：国际视角

abstract: We study an assignment market where multiple heterogenous objects are sold to unit demand agents who have general preferences that accommodate income effects and market frictions. The minimum price equilibrium (MPE) is one of the most important equilibrium concepts in such settings. Nevertheless, none of the well-known mechanisms that find the MPE in the quasi-linear settings can identify or even approximate MPEs for general preferences. We establish novel structural properties of MPEs and use them as bases to design a "Serial Vickrey (SV) mechanism." The SV mechanism finds an MPE for general preferences in a finite number of steps and only requires agents to reveal finite-dimensional information regarding their preferences in finitely many times. Besides, the SV mechanism also has nice incentive properties.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个分配市场，其中多种异质物品被出售给具有单位需求的代理，这些代理拥有能够容纳收入效应和市场摩擦的一般偏好。在此类环境中，最低价格均衡（MPE）是最重要的均衡概念之一。然而，在拟线性设定中，所有已知的能够找到MPE的著名机制都无法识别甚至近似一般偏好下的MPE。我们建立了MPE的新结构性属性，并以此为基础设计了一种“序列维克里（SV）机制”。该SV机制能在有限步骤内找到一般偏好下的MPE，并且仅要求代理在有限次数内揭示其偏好的有限维信息。此外，SV机制还具有良好的激励特性。
title: Minimum price equilibrium in the assignment market: Structural properties and the Serial Vickrey mechanism
title_zh: 指派市场中的最低价格均衡：结构性质与序列维克里机制

abstract: This study evaluates the long-term effects of a nationwide immunization program in Burkina Faso, known as the National Vaccination Commando Program, implemented in late 1984. Focusing on the measles vaccination component of the program and using a difference-in-differences approach, we find significant reductions in child mortality and improvements in educational attainment, including increased primary and secondary school completion. We also find significant positive effects on adult employment and agricultural productivity, yielding a substantial return on this early health investment. These findings underscore the lasting benefits of early childhood health interventions in low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了布基纳法索于1984年末实施的全国性免疫计划——“国家疫苗接种突击计划”的长期效应。聚焦于该计划中的麻疹疫苗接种部分，并采用双重差分法，我们发现儿童死亡率显著下降，教育成就有所提升，包括小学和中学完成率的提高。同时，我们还发现该计划对成人就业和农业生产力产生了显著的正面影响，为这一早期健康投资带来了可观的回报。这些发现强调了在低收入国家，儿童早期健康干预措施的持久益处。
title: The lasting effects of early childhood interventions: The National Vaccination Commando Program in Burkina Faso
title_zh: 早期儿童干预的持久影响：布基纳法索国家疫苗接种突击计划

abstract: This study investigates the temporal and contextual stability of social risk preferences across health and wealth, focusing on both gains and losses. Using a large representative Dutch panel, we replicated the experimental design of Attema et al. (2023) which elicited social risk preferences through allocation decisions involving two anonymous recipients under risk. The design allows us to distinguish three dimensions of preferences: risk preferences, inequality aversion, and social risk preferences arising from trade-offs between risk and inequality, corresponding to utilitarian, ex-ante, and ex-post perspectives on social welfare. At the aggregate level, the main patterns documented in the original study are largely replicated: inequality aversion is prevalent and risk aversion is weaker in the loss domain than in the gain domain. At the individual level, however, stability is more limited. Test-retest correlations are positive but modest, and the proportion of identical choices across waves varies across domains and framings. Parametric estimations further reveal substantial heterogeneity in social risk preferences. A latent-class analysis identifies utilitarian preferences as the largest group, followed by ex-post and exante perspectives. Overall, the results highlight the coexistence of persistence, contextual effects, and heterogeneity in social risk preferences
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了社会风险偏好在健康与财富领域中的时间稳定性与情境稳定性，重点关注收益与损失两种情境。基于荷兰大型代表性面板数据，我们复现了Attema等人（2023）的实验设计，该设计通过涉及两名匿名受助者在风险条件下的分配决策来测度社会风险偏好。该设计允许我们区分偏好的三个维度：风险偏好、不平等厌恶，以及由风险与不平等权衡产生的社会风险偏好，分别对应社会福利的功利主义、事前与事后视角。在总体层面，原始研究记录的主要模式基本得到复现：不平等厌恶普遍存在，且损失域中的风险厌恶程度弱于收益域。然而在个体层面，稳定性较为有限。重测相关性呈正值但幅度较小，不同轮次间完全一致的选择比例因领域与框架而异。参数估计进一步揭示了社会风险偏好的显著异质性。潜在类别分析显示，功利主义偏好群体规模最大，其次为事后与事前视角群体。总体而言，研究结果凸显了社会风险偏好中持续性、情境效应与异质性的共存特征。
title: On the Stability of Social Risk Preferences for Health and Wealth
title_zh: 关于健康与财富社会风险偏好的稳定性研究

abstract: This paper examines the effects of early-life exposure to extreme heat on children's learning achievement in India. Exploiting within-district, across-cohort variation in early-life temperature exposure, we find that greater exposure to extreme heat significantly reduces reading, writing, and mathematics achievement in later childhood. These findings remain robust across a battery of robustness checks. We further show that early-life heat exposure adversely affects children's physical development, especially among children from households with limited coping capacity and those exposed to poorer disease environments, suggesting these channels play an important role in shaping later learning achievement. Finally, projections based on future climate scenarios indicate that continued warming is likely to exacerbate human capital losses in India. These findings highlight the persistent influence of early-life climate conditions on human capital formation and underscore the importance of incorporating climate resilience into education and early childhood policy in low- and middle-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了印度儿童早期极端高温暴露对学业成就的影响。利用同一地区不同出生队列在早期温度暴露上的差异，我们发现极端高温暴露显著降低了儿童后期的阅读、写作和数学成绩。这一发现在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。进一步研究表明，早期高温暴露对儿童身体发育产生不利影响，尤其是在应对能力有限的家庭以及疾病环境较差的儿童中更为显著，这表明这些渠道在塑造后期学业成就方面发挥了重要作用。最后，基于未来气候情景的预测显示，持续变暖可能会加剧印度的人力资本损失。这些发现突显了早期气候条件对人力资本形成的持久影响，并强调了在中低收入国家将气候适应能力纳入教育和儿童早期政策的重要性。
title: Scorched Beginnings: Early-Life Heat Exposure and Learning Achievement in India
title_zh: 焦灼起点：印度早期热暴露与学业成就

abstract: At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.
abstract_zh: 在新冠疫情初期，联邦政府通过2020年3月《家庭优先新冠病毒应对法案》中的两项条款，对各州医疗补助计划的收入和支出实施了重大调整。这些条款包括将各州的联邦医疗援助比例（FMAP）提高6.2个百分点，从而增加各州收入，但前提是各州必须遵守持续参保要求。后者通过阻止因收入或其他资格相关情况变化而本应失去资格的参保者退出计划，增加了支出。尽管这些条款在事前预期将产生规模相近的支出和成本，但事后实际结果尚未量化。在全美范围内，我们估计各州承担的持续参保条款成本为1392亿美元，这比各州通过提高FMAP获得的收入总额少约110亿美元。然而，各州的收入和成本差异显著，成本超过收入的情况最高达人均594美元，而收入超过成本的情况最高达人均838美元。决定联邦政府承担各州医疗补助支出份额的基准参数，成为衡量持续参保要求是否可被视为无资金支持的联邦指令的关键因素。
title: An Unfunded Mandate? Medicaid Continuous Coverage Requirements and State Fiscal Burdens During COVID-19
title_zh: 无资金支持的命令？新冠疫情期间医疗补助持续覆盖要求与州财政负担

abstract: Contracts and ownership structures play a critical role in fostering innovation in the bioeconomy. However, identifying which designs best promote bioresource circularity and collaboration remains challenging, as existing studies use diverse frameworks and are often limited to specific contexts or regions. Therefore, we conducted a review to clarify the types of contracts and ownership structures within bio‐based value chains and evaluate their roles in fostering innovation. To this end, we followed PRISMA‐P guidelines when collecting studies and organised them based on methodologies to facilitate the synthesis. Using a framework of the ownership distribution along the value chain between primary producer and biorefinery, we categorise three main categories of ownership structures: vertical integration, individual ownership and joint ownership. Some literature argues that primary producers prefer low‐risk attributes and therefore shift much of the responsibility onto biorefineries. While such structures can encourage participation, they hinder innovation by concentrating power within the biorefinery. Joint ownership structures, such as cooperatives, emerge as promising alternatives, offering a more balanced and collaborative approach to sharing risks, costs and profits. Our findings highlight the need for future research to explore joint ownership structures and apply different methods to support substantial advancement.
abstract_zh: 合同与所有权结构在推动生物经济创新中发挥着关键作用。然而，由于现有研究采用不同分析框架且多局限于特定情境或区域，目前仍难以确定何种设计最能促进生物资源循环利用与协作。为此，我们开展系统性综述，旨在厘清生物基价值链中的合同与所有权结构类型，并评估其在促进创新中的作用。本研究遵循PRISMA-P指南进行文献收集，并按方法论分类以促进综合比较。基于初级生产者与生物精炼厂之间价值链所有权分布的分析框架，我们将所有权结构归纳为三类：纵向一体化、个体所有权与联合所有权。部分文献认为初级生产者偏好低风险属性，因此将大部分责任转移至生物精炼厂。此类结构虽能鼓励参与，但通过将权力集中于生物精炼厂而阻碍创新。合作社等联合所有权结构作为更具前景的替代方案，提供了更均衡、协作的风险、成本与利润分担方式。研究结论表明，未来需深入探索联合所有权结构，并采用多元方法推动实质性进展。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Contracts and Ownership Structures in the Bioeconomy: A Review of Their Design and Role in Innovation
title_zh: 生物经济中的合同与所有权结构：其设计与创新作用的综述

abstract: We analyze market entry efficiency in single‐ and two‐sector closed‐economy Melitz–Ottaviano (MO) models without an outside good. Comparing market and second‐best outcomes, we find that market entry is efficient in the single‐sector model. This efficiency also holds in a symmetric two‐sector setting. When sectors have asymmetric demand and the level of asymmetry is sufficiently small, the market yields excessive entry into the “high‐demand” sector. This inefficiency arises from the presence of an additional aggregator in MO preferences.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了无外部商品的单部门与两部门封闭经济Melitz–Ottaviano（MO）模型中的市场进入效率。通过比较市场结果与次优结果，我们发现单部门模型中的市场进入是有效的。这一有效性在对称的两部门设定中同样成立。当部门间存在非对称需求且非对称程度足够小时，市场会导致“高需求”部门出现过度进入。这种无效率源于MO偏好中额外加总因子的存在。
title: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups
title_zh: 异质性企业与内生加成定价下的一般均衡进入与福利

abstract: Shrinkflation, the downsizing of packages without proportional price cuts, raises effective prices in ways that are often difficult for consumers to detect under bounded attention. We exploit a documented episode of product downsizing, combined with preexisting state-level variation in unit price disclosure rules, to identify how information design affects consumer behavior and welfare. Using a matched sample of scanner data and a control function approach, we show that consumers in regulated states are three times more responsive to unit price changes, consistent with disclosure increasing the salience of the relevant price metric. Counterfactual simulations indicate that nationwide disclosure would raise annual consumer surplus by $3.03 million in the short term and $8.33 million in the long term once retailers adjust prices strategically. At present, only 16 states regulate unit price labeling on food items. Our findings demonstrate that such labeling improves consumer decision-making under shrinkflation.
abstract_zh: 缩水式通胀，即包装尺寸缩减而价格未按比例下调，会在有限注意力条件下以消费者往往难以察觉的方式提高实际价格。我们利用一次有记录的產品缩水事件，结合各州在单位价格披露规则上已有的差异，来识别信息设计如何影响消费者行为与福利。通过匹配的扫描数据样本和控制函数方法，我们表明，在受监管的州，消费者对单位价格变化的反应程度是其他州的三倍，这与披露增强了相关价格指标的显著性相一致。反事实模拟显示，若在全国范围内实施披露，短期内消费者剩余将增加303万美元，长期内，在零售商策略性调整价格后，将增加833万美元。目前，仅有16个州对食品的单位价格标签进行监管。我们的研究结果表明，此类标签在缩水式通胀情境下能改善消费者的决策质量。
title: Shrinkflation, unit price disclosure, and consumer welfare: Evidence from canned tuna
title_zh: 缩水式通胀、单价披露与消费者福利：来自金枪鱼罐头的证据

abstract: We revisit the question of the role of Hand-to-Mouth (HtM) households in monetary policy transmission across European countries, using the Household Finance and Consumption Survey (HFCS). Using European Central Bank (ECB) monetary shocks and panel local projections, we find that the aggregate output response of countries with higher HtM ratios is less pronounced following monetary policy shocks compared to those with lower HtM ratios. This aligns with the predictions of heterogeneous agent New Keynesian models with both wage and price rigidity. When wages are stickier than prices, real wages for HtM agents may decline despite interest rate cuts, which hinders the demand boost typically expected from the New Keynesian Cross. Consequently, monetary policy is less effective in stimulating aggregate demand in economies with a higher share of HtM households.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了手到口（HtM）家庭在欧洲各国货币政策传导中的作用，利用家庭金融与消费调查（HFCS）数据。借助欧洲中央银行（ECB）的货币冲击和面板局部投影方法，我们发现，在货币政策冲击后，HtM比率较高的国家，其总体产出反应相较于HtM比率较低的国家更为温和。这一发现与同时包含工资和价格粘性的异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型的预测相符。当工资比价格更具粘性时，尽管利率下调，HtM代理人的实际工资可能下降，这阻碍了新凯恩斯交叉通常预期的需求提振效应。因此，在HtM家庭占比更高的经济体中，货币政策在刺激总需求方面的效果较弱。
title: Hand-to-mouth households in the eurosystem and the transmission of monetary policy
title_zh: 欧元体系中的手头拮据家庭与货币政策的传导

abstract: Central bank policy decisions shape the economy both by influencing market conditions and by affecting expectations. These expectations can be driven by two simultaneous shocks: monetary and information shocks. Identifying the information shock as one with a non-negative effect on expectations, this paper shows that such shocks are highly relevant in emerging markets. In particular, inflation and output forecasts tend to increase in the short run following an unexpected rise in the policy rate. This pattern can be reconciled with baseline New Keynesian models only if the policy rate gives information about shocks that generate a positive co-movement between the interest rate, inflation, and output. The findings suggest that information shocks are an important part of monetary policy surprises.
abstract_zh: 央行政策决策通过影响市场条件和预期来塑造经济。这些预期可能受到两种同时发生的冲击驱动：货币冲击和信息冲击。本文将信息冲击识别为对预期具有非负效应的冲击，并表明此类冲击在新兴市场中尤为重要。具体而言，在政策利率意外上升后，通胀和产出预测往往在短期内上升。这一模式只有在政策利率提供关于产生利率、通胀和产出正协同运动的冲击的信息时，才能与基准新凯恩斯模型相吻合。研究结果表明，信息冲击是货币政策意外的重要组成部分。
title: Is the information channel of monetary policy alive in emerging markets?
title_zh: 新兴市场货币政策的信息渠道是否有效？

abstract: Can history explain some of the variation in electric heating usage across American homes today? Assembling a new county panel, we find that areas with more dwellings built before WWII are slower at adopting electric heating in later decades. This is due to old buildings being retrofitted more slowly and new buildings being less likely to have electric heating. We propose two ways to distinguish between persistence and path dependence as mechanisms, and show that our results largely reflect the latter. We document how various factors like natural disasters and government intervention can weaken the hold of history.
abstract_zh: 历史能否解释当今美国家庭电采暖使用差异的部分原因？通过构建新的县级面板数据，我们发现二战前建造的住宅较多的地区，在后续几十年中采用电采暖的速度较慢。这归因于老旧建筑改造进程缓慢，以及新建建筑采用电采暖的可能性较低。我们提出两种方法来区分持续性与路径依赖作为机制，并表明我们的结果在很大程度上反映了后者。我们记录了自然灾害和政府干预等多种因素如何削弱历史的影响。
title: Locked in the past: Old housing and the adoption of electric heating

abstract: The low-altitude economy, as an emerging economic form integrating aviation technology, digital technologies, and traditional industries, has in recent years been recognized as a new engine driving economic transformation and upgrading. Drawing on endogenous growth theory and the analytical framework of emerging productivity, this study examines the impact of the low-altitude economy (LAE) city pilot policy on enterprise total factor productivity (TFP). Utilizing panel data from Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share listed companies between 2016 and 2023, we examine the underlying mechanisms using a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) approach. The results demonstrate that low-altitude economy city pilot policy significantly enhances enterprise TFP. The low-altitude economy city pilot policy can optimize capital allocation, enhance supply chain collaboration, and advance technological progress, and thereby contribute to improving enterprise TFP. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the TFP-enhancing is more pronounced for technology-intensive and manufacturing enterprises, as well as for firms located in regions characterized by stronger intellectual property protection. This study provides empirical evidence on the micro-level mechanisms of new-type productivity from the perspective of the low-altitude economy and offers policy insights for developing economies.
abstract_zh: 低空经济作为融合航空技术、数字技术与传统产业的新兴经济形态，近年来被视为推动经济转型升级的新引擎。本研究基于内生增长理论与新质生产力的分析框架，探讨低空经济城市试点政策对企业全要素生产率的影响。利用2016至2023年间上海和深圳A股上市公司的面板数据，我们采用交错双重差分法考察其内在机制。结果表明，低空经济城市试点政策显著提升了企业全要素生产率。低空经济城市试点政策能够优化资本配置、增强供应链协同并促进技术进步，从而有助于提高企业全要素生产率。异质性分析显示，对于技术密集型企业和制造业企业，以及位于知识产权保护较强地区的企业，全要素生产率的提升效应更为显著。本研究从低空经济视角提供了新质生产力微观机制的经验证据，并为发展中经济体提供了政策启示。

abstract: We study the frictions in dealer-intermediation in residential real estate through the lens of "iBuyers," technology entrants, who purchase and sell residential real estate through online platforms. iBuyers supply liquidity to households by allowing them to avoid a lengthy sale process. They sell houses quickly and earn a 5% spread. Their prices are well explained by a simple hedonic model, consistent with their use of algorithmic pricing. iBuyers choose to intermediate in markets that are liquid, and in which automated valuation models have low pricing error. These facts suggest that iBuyers' speedy offers may come at the cost of information loss concerning house attributes that are difficult to capture in an algorithm, resulting in adverse selection. We calibrate a dynamic structural search model with adverse selection to understand and quantify the economic forces underlying the tradeoffs of dealer intermediation in this market.
abstract_zh: 我们通过“iBuyers”（技术新进入者）的视角，研究住宅房地产中经销商中介的摩擦，这些iBuyers通过在线平台购买和销售住宅房地产。iBuyers通过允许家庭避免冗长的销售过程来提供流动性。他们快速出售房屋并赚取5%的价差。其价格能很好地由一个简单的特征价格模型解释，这与他们使用算法定价的做法一致。iBuyers选择在流动性强且自动估值模型定价误差低的市场中进行中介。这些事实表明，iBuyers的快速报价可能以损失难以在算法中捕捉的房屋属性信息为代价，从而导致逆向选择。我们校准了一个包含逆向选择的动态结构搜索模型，以理解和量化该市场中经销商中介权衡背后的经济力量。

abstract: This study investigates the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) applications on the overseas investment efficiency of Chinese multinational enterprises using firm-level data from 2008 to 2023. The results show that AI can significantly improve investment efficiency. Mechanism analysis indicates that AI plays roles by mitigating managerial myopia and enhancing dynamic capabilities. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the positive effects of AI are more pronounced in host countries characterized by high economic policy uncertainty and greater institutional distance. Concurrently, the enabling effects of AI vary depending on firms’ organizational learning capabilities and political connectedness. These findings underscore the transformative potential of AI in refining multinational enterprises’ investment strategies, strengthening global competitiveness, and facilitating adaptation to diverse institutional and economic contexts, thereby providing actionable insights for improving international investment performance.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2008年至2023年的企业层面数据，探讨了人工智能应用对中国跨国企业海外投资效率的影响。结果显示，人工智能能显著提升投资效率。机制分析表明，人工智能通过缓解管理者短视和增强动态能力发挥作用。异质性分析显示，在经济政策不确定性高和制度距离大的东道国，人工智能的积极效应更为显著。同时，人工智能的赋能效果因企业的组织学习能力和政治关联度而异。这些发现强调了人工智能在优化跨国企业投资策略、增强全球竞争力以及适应不同制度和经济环境方面的变革潜力，从而为提升国际投资绩效提供了可行的见解。

abstract: This study examines how the expansion of public childcare is associated with the exit dynamics of existing childcare facilities in South Korea. Using comprehensive facility-level data covering all operating and closed childcare centres, we estimate fixed-effects models with lagged entry variables. Newly established public childcare centres are associated with a significant increase in exits among non-public facilities, whereas public facilities are largely unaffected by new public entry. We interpret this pattern as evidence that public expansion restructures local childcare markets. This market adjustment is not necessarily welfare-reducing: public expansion may improve affordability, accessibility, and service quality even as it changes the provider mix. Our findings therefore suggest that evaluations of public childcare expansion should consider both the benefits of public provision and the ownership-specific adjustment pressures that arise in local childcare markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了韩国公共托育服务的扩展与现有托育设施退出动态之间的关联。利用涵盖所有运营中及已关闭托育中心的全面设施层面数据，我们估计了包含滞后进入变量的固定效应模型。新设立的公共托育中心与非公共设施退出率显著增加相关，而公共设施则基本不受新公共进入的影响。我们将这一模式解读为公共扩展重塑了地方托育市场的证据。这种市场调整未必会降低福利：公共扩展可能改善可负担性、可及性和服务质量，即便它改变了提供者结构。因此，我们的研究结果表明，对公共托育扩展的评估应同时考虑公共供给的益处以及地方托育市场中因所有权特定调整压力而产生的影响。

abstract: Cropland non-agriculturalization, encompassing permanent loss and transitions to non-grain uses, drives global food insecurity. However, accurately mapping these diverse pathways across large spatiotemporal scales remains methodologically elusive. To address this, we developed a novel approach integrating multi-index temporal-spectral segmentation (LandTrendr) with Random Forest (RF) classification to map three primary cropland conversion types in China (1991–2020): conversion to non-grain uses, waterbody, and built-up land. Crucially, to explicitly overcome phenological confounding effects, we innovatively utilized the Coefficient of Variation (CV) of vegetation indices to suppress seasonal noise and extract robust inter-annual cultivation features. By employing the LandTrendr algorithm to segment these CV metrics and other multi-spectral indices, we detected the features of distinct disturbances, which subsequently served as predictors within an RF framework to map the different cropland non-agriculturalization types. This methodology yielded an 87.5 ± 1.0% overall accuracy. China's non-agriculturalized cropland reached 426,388 km2, comprising conversions to non-grain (312,771 km2), built-up (92,462 km2), and waterbody (21,155 km2). Spatially, non-grain conversions concentrated in the Northeast China Plain and northern arid/semi-arid regions. Waterbody transitions aggregated in the Middle and Lower Yangtze Plain, while built-up land expansion dominated major coastal and urban agglomerations (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze/Pearl River Deltas). Temporally, non-grain transitions exhibited early fluctuating upward trajectories, whereas waterbody and built-up conversions peaked in 2001 and 2013, respectively. Ultimately, this research establishes a robust multi-index framework capable of untangling concurrent cropland non-agriculturalization types over vast extents. By accurately attributing spatially explicit transitions, our methodology offers a reliable mechanism for continuous monitoring and a strong empirical basis for global sustainable agricultural policies.
abstract_zh: 耕地非农化，涵盖永久性丧失及向非粮用途的转变，威胁着全球粮食安全。然而，在广阔时空尺度上精确绘制这些多样化的转变路径，在方法论上仍具挑战性。为此，我们开发了一种新方法，整合多指数时间-光谱分割（LandTrendr）与随机森林（RF）分类，以绘制中国1991-2020年间三种主要耕地转化类型：非粮化、水域化和建设用地化。关键创新在于，为明确克服物候混淆效应，我们创新性地利用植被指数变异系数（CV）抑制季节性噪声，提取稳健的年内耕作特征。通过应用LandTrendr算法分割这些CV指标及其他多光谱指数，我们检测了不同干扰的特征，这些特征随后作为RF框架内的预测因子，用于绘制不同耕地非农化类型图。该方法总体精度达到87.5±1.0%。中国非农化耕地面积达426,388平方公里，包括非粮化（312,771平方公里）、建设用地化（92,462平方公里）和水域化（21,155平方公里）。空间上，非粮化转变集中于东北平原及北方干旱/半干旱地区。水域化转变聚集于长江中下游平原，而建设用地扩张主导了主要沿海及城市群（京津冀、长三角、珠三角）。时间上，非粮化转变呈现早期波动上升趋势，而水域化和建设用地化转变分别于2001年和2013年达到峰值。最终，本研究建立了一个稳健的多指数框架，能够在大范围内解析并存的耕地非农化类型。通过精确归因空间显式转变，我们的方法为持续监测提供了可靠机制，并为全球可持续农业政策提供了坚实的实证基础。

abstract: According to endogenous growth theory, temporary changes in R&D spending affect the flow of new technologies only temporarily, but their cumulative effect permanently alters the stock of knowledge and thus the level of aggregate productivity. Because R&D is pro-cyclical, business cycles and long-run growth may be connected. If shocks and responses are symmetric, the effects cancel out; if they are asymmetric, business cycle volatility and long-term growth become interdependent. We test for such asymmetries in U.S. aggregate R&D using standard empirical techniques. The main findings are that: (i) R&D spending expansions are 40% longer than contractions, but differences in their rapidity are not statistically significant; (ii) the pro-cyclicality of R&D is stronger when unemployment is particularly low; (iii) the pro-cyclicality of R&D is stronger when financing opportunities are more abundant. Therefore, the results underscore the importance of economic booms for understanding R&D’s pro-cyclicality, especially in periods of tight labor markets and easy credit. Moreover, we point to promising avenues for theory to explain these findings.
abstract_zh: 根据内生增长理论，研发支出的临时变动仅暂时影响新技术流，但其累积效应却永久性地改变知识存量，进而影响总体生产率水平。由于研发活动具有顺周期性，商业周期与长期增长之间可能存在联系。若冲击与响应呈对称性，则效应相互抵消；若呈非对称性，则商业周期波动与长期增长相互依存。我们运用标准实证技术，对美国总体研发活动中的此类非对称性进行了检验。主要发现如下：（i）研发支出扩张期比收缩期长约40%，但两者速度差异在统计上并不显著；（ii）当失业率特别低时，研发的顺周期性更为显著；（iii）当融资机会更为充裕时，研发的顺周期性亦更为突出。因此，研究结果强调了经济繁荣期对于理解研发顺周期性的重要性，尤其是在劳动力市场紧张和信贷条件宽松的时期。此外，我们指出了理论解释这些发现有前景的方向。
title: Business cycles, R&D, and hysteresis: searching for asymmetries
title_zh: 商业周期、研发与滞后效应：非对称性探究

abstract: This study investigates how science, technology, and finance (STF) policies improve urban green transformation and competitiveness. Utilizing a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model, we analyse panel data from 285 Chinese cities spanning the period 2006–2022 to assess the effect and underlying mechanisms of STF policies on urban green competitiveness. Results show that the implementation of STF policies significantly enhances urban green competitiveness, with an average improvement ranging from 8.12% to 9.18%. Our analysis of the underlying mechanisms reveals that this improvement is driven by three key factors: increased financial incentives for research and development, a rise in green patent awards, and improved total factor productivity. These findings demonstrate that STF policies enhance urban green competitiveness both directly and indirectly through innovation and productivity gains. In addition, we highlight the heterogeneity of STF policy effects across regions, city sizes, resource endowments, and city clusters. Our study provides new empirical evidence and policy insights to guide regions in harnessing the combined power of science, technology, and finance to achieve green and sustainable urban development.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了科技金融（STF）政策如何促进城市绿色转型与竞争力提升。利用多期双重差分（DID）模型，我们分析了2006年至2022年间中国285个城市的面板数据，以评估STF政策对城市绿色竞争力的影响及其内在机制。结果显示，STF政策的实施显著增强了城市绿色竞争力，平均提升幅度介于8.12%至9.18%之间。机制分析表明，这一提升主要由三个关键因素驱动：研发财政激励的增加、绿色专利授权的增长以及全要素生产率的提高。这些发现证明，STF政策通过创新与生产率提升，直接及间接地增强了城市绿色竞争力。此外，我们强调了STF政策效应在区域、城市规模、资源禀赋及城市群间的异质性。本研究提供了新的实证证据与政策启示，以指导各地区利用科技、金融的协同力量，实现绿色可持续的城市发展。
